*Must be a U.S. citizen (U.S. born or naturalized) living on U.S. soil who does not hold dual citizenship with the ability to meet customer and government screening standards applicable to this role.**

**Candidates interested in the Hawaii location must be based in Oahu or DC, Northern VA, WMATA.**

**PLEASE NOTE: Qualification for this job is contingent upon acceptable results from a background investigation as well as your having and maintaining the specific level of U.S. government background investigation and clearance required for this role.**

---

About the Role

We believe technology should serve the greater good—powering mission outcomes, stewarding taxpayer resources, and enabling innovation at speed and scale. We are seeking a highly accomplished and senior-level Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our elite Public Sector team. This is a unique and high-impact position, blending the roles of a hands-on data scientist, integration architect, and strategic partner embedded directly with customers.

In this role, you will be the primary driver for bringing cutting-edge data science pipelines, intelligent automation, and enterprise integration solutions to life for mission-critical work across the U.S. Department of Defense, Intelligence Community (IC), and Aerospace & Allied Nations.

This role demands a seasoned technologist who thrives working forward-deployed at customer sites, building bespoke solutions leveraging enterprise workflow orchestration platforms such as Regrello and API-led connectivity platforms such as MuleSoft, while also designing and delivering advanced AI/ML systems. Candidates with equivalent experience in comparable platforms are strongly encouraged to apply; direct experience with these specific tools is a plus. You will work directly with mission owners and internal teams—from initial concept through deployment and ongoing optimization—to solve the most complex data and integration challenges in national security environments.

---

Mission Impact

- Deploy Cutting-Edge Data Science & Integration Innovation—from API-led integration ecosystems to orchestrated operational workflows to advanced ML pipelines—directly at customer sites in defense, intelligence, and aerospace environments, accelerating mission transformation. Experience with platforms such as MuleSoft and Regrello, or comparable tools, is leveraged to deliver these outcomes.

-Become a Trusted Partner Embedded with Mission Owners, working in classified and unclassified environments to deeply understand operational challenges and translate them into end-to-end data science and integration solutions using best-fit tooling.

- Drive Innovation at the Front Lines by serving as the connective bridge between customer missions and internal engineering teams, gathering frontline feedback to help co-design integration patterns, workflow templates, and data science capabilities that strengthen national security outcomes.

- Improve Efficiency, Mission-Readiness, and Trust by helping the U.S. and allied governments deploy integrated data technology stacks that deliver faster response times, better personnel utilization, and more effective logistics and asset management.

- Drive Tangible Outcomes through Hands-On Implementation, taking responsibility for end-to-end technical delivery of complex data pipelines, integration flows, and predictive models—personally writing critical code, configuring systems, and troubleshooting issues in the field while guiding junior team members.

- Build Transformative Data Science Solutions by taking primary ownership of designing, developing, and implementing high-quality, scalable production ML and analytics systems, including predictive models, intelligent automation pipelines, and LLM-augmented workflows.

-Engineer Bespoke Integration Architectures, designing and building custom API-led integrations using enterprise integration platforms—such as MuleSoft Anypoint Platform or equivalent middleware solutions—to ensure seamless connectivity across enterprise data sources, operational systems, and cloud environments in highly regulated settings. Demonstrated experience with comparable iPaaS or API management platforms (e.g., Dell Boomi, Azure API Management, Apigee, AWS API Gateway) is strongly considered; direct MuleSoft experience is a plus.

- Orchestrate Complex Workflows, leveraging modern workflow automation and process orchestration platforms—such as Regrello or equivalent solutions—to model, automate, and optimize multi-stakeholder operational processes in manufacturing, logistics, supply chain, and mission operations contexts. Candidates with hands-on experience in comparable platforms (e.g., Temporal, Prefect, Apache Airflow, ServiceNow) are strongly encouraged to apply; direct Regrello experience is a plus.

- Own the Entire Data Lifecycle- on-site with customers—from strategic data modeling to hands-on ETL/ELT pipeline construction, feature engineering, and integration strategy—ensuring data is always ready, optimized, and secure for advanced analytics and AI applications.

- Lead Rapid Prototyping and Iteration, developing proofs-of-concept and MVPs side-by-side with customer teams to demonstrate data science and integration capabilities and set the pace for rapid, mission-aligned delivery.

---

Mission Responsibilities

- Serve as the forward-deployed technical lead on high-profile customer engagements—designing, building, and deploying tailored data science and integration solutions for defense, intelligence, and aerospace missions on-site.

- Architect and implement enterprise integration solutions—using platforms such as MuleSoft Anypoint Platform or equivalent iPaaS tooling—including API design, development, and management across REST, SOAP, and event-driven integration patterns within secure customer environments.

- Design and deploy workflow automation solutions—leveraging platforms such as Regrello or equivalent orchestration tooling—to model complex operational processes, coordinate cross-functional teams, and surface data-driven insights at key mission decision points.

- Lead integration of AI/ML models, custom data pipelines, and automation flows that enable predictive maintenance, personnel planning, and mission-critical logistics decisions.

- Work with customer IT and security teams to accelerate Authority to Operate (ATO) and production go-lives per DoD IL5/IL6 and applicable regulatory frameworks.

- Partner with internal product and engineering teams to co-develop integration patterns and data science capabilities informed by frontline customer feedback.

- Enable customers to adopt modern data platforms and integration middleware for field operations, asset visibility, command center analytics, and secure operational workflows.

- Mentor junior FDEs and share lessons learned with the broader engineering community to shape playbooks, integration templates, and reusable data science assets for government innovation.

- Translate mission priorities into actionable data and integration roadmaps aligned with agency strategy, presenting findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

---

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a builder, a problem solver, and a mission-first leader who thrives in forward-deployed environments. The ideal candidate brings:

- 8+ years of experience in a hands-on, end-to-end delivery role for high-quality, scalable production solutions, ideally in customer-facing or field-deployed settings.

- Strong background in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related engineering discipline.

- Expert-level proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, SQL).

- Extensive hands-on experience building and deploying AI/ML solutions, including model development, MLOps pipelines, LLM integration, prompt engineering, and agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex).

- Demonstrated expertise in enterprise integration platforms and API-led connectivity design, with experience in tools such as MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, Dell Boomi, Apigee, Azure API Management, or equivalent; direct MuleSoft experience is a plus.

- Demonstrated expertise in workflow orchestration and process automation platforms, with experience in tools such as Regrello, Temporal, Prefect, Apache Airflow, or equivalent; direct Regrello experience is a plus.

- Deep expertise in data modeling, processing, and analytics with demonstrable proficiency in enterprise data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift).

- A "get-things-done" attitude with a proven ability to deliver fast and impactfully in ambiguous, customer-site environments.

- Exceptional communication and presentation skills—able to articulate complex data science and integration concepts to both technical and non-technical mission stakeholders.

- Proven ability to lead technical engagements, mentor junior FDEs, and own technical delivery end-to-end.

- **Ability to travel 50-75% of the time to customer sites, including classified facilities.**

- **Must be a U.S. citizen (U.S. born or naturalized) living on U.S. soil who does not hold dual citizenship.**

- **Eligible for and willing to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance.**

---

Preferred Qualifications

- Prior experience in a forward-deployed, field engineer, or embedded technical advisor role with direct customer engagement.

- Experience supporting U.S. Department of Defense (DoD), Intelligence Community (IC), or Federal Civilian agencies.

- Background in defense, aerospace, or military logistics operations.

- Familiarity with IL5/IL6/CNSS #1253 requirements or deployment to classified environments.

- Direct hands-on experience with MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, including advanced DataWeave and Runtime Fabric deployments.

- Direct hands-on experience with Regrello for operational workflow orchestration in manufacturing, supply chain, or logistics domains.

- Expert-level Python and/or Java proficiency in a professional data science or integration engineering setting.

- Experience developing and deploying LLM-augmented solutions within highly regulated or classified industries.

- Relevant platform certifications such as:
- MuleSoft Certified Developer / Architect
- Databricks Certified Associate/Professional
- AWS/GCP/Azure Data or ML Engineer certifications
- Data Science and Analysis Certifications or relevant experience

- Experience with event-driven architectures, messaging systems (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ), and streaming data pipelines.

- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and DevSecOps practices in regulated environments.

Job Title: Senior Product Security Engineer, Infrastructure
Job Category: Technology / Security
Location: San Francisco, CA or Bellevue, WA

The Experience

Join our Infrastructure Product Security Assurance team as a Senior Product Security Engineer, where you play a pivotal role in fortifying the bedrock of Salesforce's entire product ecosystem. In this highly impactful position, you leverage deep technical expertise to provide strategic security guidance and leadership to engineering teams responsible for our foundational services, including technical controls, infrastructure databases, and monitoring tools across public cloud platforms.

As a trusted security engineer, you serve as the primary point of contact for engineering partners and leadership, cultivating strong relationships and delivering critical security recommendations. Your contributions directly shape and enhance the security posture of our core infrastructure platforms, ensuring the resilience and integrity of Salesforce's offerings.

Our team specializes in providing deep architectural and infrastructure security expertise across a diverse range of technologies, both on-premises and in public cloud environments, including web applications, distributed systems, and virtualized infrastructures. You champion secure software development lifecycle (SSDL) best practices, empowering engineering teams to build secure products from the ground up.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Provide expert security advisory for large-scale cloud initiatives, offering strategic guidance to engineering teams on complex enterprise architectures across the application and infrastructure stack.
  • Drive proactive security through architecture and threat modeling, partnering with engineering teams to identify vulnerabilities and develop risk mitigation plans throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Influence secure design and implementation by collaborating with product teams to recommend design solutions that balance functional goals with security requirements.
  • Align security priorities with business risk by working with Product Business Information Security Officers (BISOs) to curate and prioritize risk-based security initiatives, and by analyzing risk signals and emerging threats to shape security roadmaps.



You're Our Person If...

  • You have 5-8 years of experience in a security engineering, security architecture, or security assurance role.
  • Cloud Security: You have experience securing products and infrastructure across one or more public cloud environments (Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure, Alibaba Cloud, or equivalent), with an understanding of cloud service models, shared responsibility boundaries, and identity primitives at scale.
  • Threat Modeling & Risk Assessment: You have experience conducting structured security design reviews and threat modeling across infrastructure and application security domains, with familiarity with common vulnerability classes (Open Web Application Security Project (OWASP) Top 10, Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) Top 25), and can evaluate and communicate security risk to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • Identity, Access, and Network Fundamentals: You understand authentication and authorization patterns including Open Authorization (OAuth) / OpenID Connect (OIDC), Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), service-to-service authentication, and API authorization models, as well as TCP/IP, Transport Layer Security (TLS), network segmentation, and key management, certificate lifecycles, secrets handling, and encryption standards.
  • You have strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence engineering teams toward secure outcomes without relying on direct organizational authority.



Even Better If...

  • You can reason through abuse cases and attack paths, not just defensive recommendations, with some familiarity with penetration testing methodologies or offensive security techniques.
  • You have experience participating in or driving improvements to a secure development lifecycle, security review process, or security advisory program within an engineering organization.
  • You can work with structured data, identify patterns across a broad service portfolio, and propose mitigations that address root causes rather than individual findings.
  • You can read and reason about code in one or more languages common in cloud-native engineering environments — particularly Java, Go, or Python — and have hands-on familiarity with container orchestration and workload security (Kubernetes, Docker, service mesh such as Istio), secrets/key management and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) tooling, Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and vulnerability scanning tools, or static analysis (SAST) and infrastructure-as-code security scanning.

This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, platform architecture, and applied AI, requiring you to guide customer Chief Data Officers and Enterprise Architects through emerging AI solutions. You will work side-by-side with Account Executives and Product teams to ensure customers realize the full value of the platform by designing scalable, secure solutions that integrate D360 into complex enterprise ecosystems—including hyperscalers, data lakes, and governance frameworks.

Responsibilities

  • Lead pre-sales technical design by analyzing customer needs and recommending solutions aligned with Agentforce capabilities and integration with external agent frameworks.

  • Shape best practices around generative AI, agent interoperability, prompt engineering, Data Cloud, and cross-platform integrations.

  • Collaborate with AEs and SEs to build hands-on prototypes and demos using Agentforce and integrated external agents.

  • Develop thought leadership content—demo templates, whitepapers, enablement sessions—focused on agent lifecycle, integration strategy, and technical effectiveness.

  • Act as a central technical knowledge resource, proactively addressing internal technical inquiries, facilitating deep technical enablement, and documenting best practices to empower specialist teams across the organization.

  • If you are naturally curious about AI and Data, love diving into new technologies, and enjoy educating others while crafting solutions that deliver real business impact, we want to talk to you!

  • Understand Agent Interoperability - Map and integrate external agents from hyperscalers (e.g. Copilot, Gemini) into Agentforce via open standards (MCP, A2A); design how these systems collaborate.

  • Enable Conversational & Background Agents - Use Agentforce Studio and Agent Builder to configure chat and background agents; integrate with external channels including voice via hyperscaler APIs.

  • Drive Prompt Engineering & Lifecycle Strategy - Lead prompt design, testing, monitoring, and iteration; define agent lifecycle best practices from development through refinement.

  • Build Hands-On Demos & Prototypes - Co-create quick prototypes (<2 weeks) with AEs demonstrating integration between Agentforce and external agents or services.

  • Lead Pre-Sales Workshops - Facilitate whiteboarding, deep-dive sessions, and quick enablement for customers and internal teams.

  • Advise on Data & Integration - Integrate Data Cloud (D360), CRM, MuleSoft APIs, and external agent endpoints ensuring cohesive architectures that align with compliance and governance policies.

  • Support Early Adoption - Occasionally assist in proof-of-value engagements post-sale by tuning agents and guiding customers toward self-sufficient enablement.

  • Own Technical Architecture Decisions - Oversee data modeling, identity resolution, real-time vs. batch patterns, data graph design, and activation strategies within D360.

  • Own Technical Enablement - Create and manage accessible technical documentation, knowledge bases, and FAQ resources to rapidly resolve internal technical inquiries, empowering specialist teams to handle technical discussions confidently.


Required Qualifications

  • Technical Pre-Sales/Consulting - 7+ years of hands-on experience designing and delivering data, analytics, and AI architectures in enterprise environments.

  • External Ecosystem Knowledge - Strong understanding of external agent ecosystems and interoperability.

  • Proven Track Record - Experience in prompt engineering, agent lifecycle management, and hands-on prototype development.

  • AI & ML Expertise - Experience with machine learning concepts (predictive and generative AI), plus the ability to communicate value to diverse audiences.

  • Data Stack Knowledge - Deep expertise in modern cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift) and data ingestion patterns (batch, streaming, CDC).

  • Hands-On Development - Proficiency in programming (e.g., JavaScript, Python, SQL, R) and data frameworks like pandas or Jupyter.

  • Excellent Communication - Strong presentation skills; adept at explaining complex ideas and guiding stakeholders toward impactful solutions.

  • Curiosity & Continuous Learning - Passion for exploring new AI frameworks, sharing insights, and experimenting with cutting-edge technologies.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Expertise - Hands-on experience with Salesforce Agentforce and deep fluency with D360 and core Salesforce platform services.

  • Advanced Integration - Experience integrating Salesforce with external agents via APIs and open standards (MCP, A2A).

  • Governance & Observability - Familiarity with prompt governance, observability, and monitoring frameworks.

  • Cross-Platform Background - Background in cross-platform integrations (e.g., Hyperscaler SDKs to Salesforce Flows).

  • Multimodal Pipelines - Prior exposure to conversational voice pipelines or multimodal integrations via hyperscaler services.

  • Advanced AI/ML Frameworks - Exposure to frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), MLOps practices, and cloud AI platforms like Google Vertex AI or AWS Sagemaker.

descriptionHtml:

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Salesforce is looking for a Technical Product Strategist to join its Product Strategy & Innovation team. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of market dynamics, product positioning, and complex technical architecture, helping define where Salesforce invests, how we position our platform, and why.

You will contribute to our forward-looking technology thesis. Rather than managing sprint backlogs, feature prioritization, or short-term execution roadmaps, you will work within a team of technical product strategists to identify emerging opportunities ("white spaces"), evaluate "build-buy-partner" options, and translate major market trends into concrete platform strategies.

We are looking for a strategy professional who can anticipate trends: someone who can methodically analyze portfolio gaps, evaluate technical investment options, and help design the strategic frameworks that will shape our enterprise platform.

From analyzing the productization trajectories of key capabilities (from trust infrastructure to workflow automation to agentic AI architectures) to researching investment theses in high-growth areas such as supply chain agentification, developer tools, and AI-native systems of record, you will help Salesforce make the right bets through solid commercial and technical models.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Support long-term product strategy: Conduct market studies, whitespace analyses, and competitive assessments to support multi-year positioning frameworks across Salesforce's enterprise AI and platform portfolio.
  • Analyze productization trajectories: Evaluate the strategic transition of internal technical capabilities (trust infrastructure, workflow automation, agentic AI, and data platforms) into standalone product lines or platform-integrated offerings.
  • Apply "Build-Buy-Partner" frameworks: Conduct structured assessments for internal development, acquisition, or partnership decisions, analyzing platform integration timelines against independent go-to-market strategies.
  • Translate technology and market paradigms: Track fundamental shifts (including agentic coding, AI-native application architectures, supply chain automation, and open source ecosystems) and translate them into clear, data-backed investment theses.
  • Map portfolio gaps: Collaborate with strategy and product management leaders to identify portfolio vulnerabilities and market opportunities beyond traditional competitive analysis.
  • Synthesize cross-functional signals: Integrate technical research, engineering capabilities, strategic market intelligence, and M&A (mergers and acquisitions) trends into solid, well-supported strategic perspectives.
  • Assess market viability: Perform market sizing, economic modeling, and competitive analyses to justify capital allocation and strategic redirections.
  • Support global strategic initiatives: Work with regional leadership to adapt platform strategies to international markets, accounting for local regulatory frameworks and the competitive landscape.
  • Evaluate go-to-market models: Analyze monetization structures (open source, platform integration, standalone SaaS, API-first), balancing long-term revenue potential, developer adoption, and defensibility.
  • Monitor emerging signals: Track venture capital activity, developer ecosystem shifts, and emerging research to identify new technology paradigms before they become consensus.
  • Make recommendations to the leadership committee: Write clear, well-structured strategic memos and presentations for chief strategy officers, product VPs, and executive leaders.



You're Our Person If...

  • 5 to 8 years of experience (post-bachelor's or advanced degree) in product strategy, technology strategy, corporate strategy, management consulting, or technical product management at a major cloud or enterprise software company.
  • Strong structural understanding of enterprise AI/ML architectures, agentic systems, and platform integration patterns.
  • Command of enterprise systems of record, data platforms, and SaaS infrastructure, including an understanding of how AI layers affect the software business model.
  • Solid foundation in business model design, including the trade-offs between open source, proprietary, platform-native, and API-led go-to-market models.
  • Experience participating in build-buy-partner assessments, go-to-market strategies, or market studies for mergers and acquisitions.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to translate complex, multivariable technical topics into concise narratives for executives.
  • Strong comfort with ambiguity and solid quantitative and qualitative problem-solving skills to structure complex issues and test strategic hypotheses.



Even Better If...

  • Experience in technical strategy, corporate innovation, or technology strategy consulting.
  • Knowledge of developer platform ecosystems, AI-assisted software development, and modern developer tools.
  • Hands-on experience or deep knowledge in enterprise supply chain automation, process agentification, or vertical AI applications.

Global supply chains still rely on slow, manual processes—email, spreadsheets, and fragmented data. Nowhere does modernizing them matter more than in the public sector, where the scale and stakes are highest.


Missionforce Operations is reimagining the public sector supply chain with an AI-powered platform for designing, automating, and running end-to-end business processes, with seamless collaboration through familiar channels like email. descriptionHtml:

Job Details

About Salesforce

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About the Role

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.

The Builder Experience
 

  • AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.

  • Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.

  • Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time. You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures — and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them.

  • Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.



What You'll Actually Be Building
 

  • Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.

  • Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.

  • Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.

  • Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output.

  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.

  • Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.

  • Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.

  • Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.

  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.



You're Our Forward Deployed Engineer If…
 

  • You have 3+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you'd be proud to walk us through — ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models.

  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field.

  • You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.

  • You're fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.

  • You've been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you'd change.

  • You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.

  • You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.

  • You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.

  • You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.

  • You thrive in the group chat that's building something, not just talking about it.

  • You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.



Nice-to-Haves
 

  • Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)

  • Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns

  • Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)

  • Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

À propos du poste

Expérience en production requise. Mentalité Builder non négociable.

Salesforce recrute des Forward Deployed Engineers — des Technical Builders expérimentés qui conçoivent, développent et déploient des solutions d'IA agentique directement dans les environnements clients en entreprise. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe de delivery, en étroite collaboration avec un Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder — un conseiller orienté client qui façonne la stratégie IA et pilote l'adoption) pour co-construire des solutions mises en production dès le premier jour. Les missions vont d'un grand compte stratégique unique à plusieurs comptes simultanés. Le fil conducteur : du vrai code, de vrais environnements, et un impact business mesurable. Ce travail couvre la configuration, la personnalisation et le déploiement full-stack — en livrant des solutions dont les clients dépendent.

L'expérience Builder
 

  • Développement assisté par l'IA : Livrez de vraies solutions clients, avec les meilleurs outils IA du marché — Cursor, Claude, et les produits Salesforce comme Vibes — intégrés à votre quotidien.

  • Delivery collaboratif : Vous travaillerez aux côtés de Senior Forward Deployed Engineers et d'un Deployment Strategist. Vous serez responsable de composants concrets, bénéficierez d'un mentorat structuré de personnes ayant déjà livré des systèmes agentiques à grande échelle, avec une trajectoire claire vers la conduite de projets complexes.

  • Accès à la frontière technologique : Notre plateforme d'IA agentique évolue en temps réel. Vous travaillerez sur des capacités que la plupart des ingénieurs n'aborderont pas avant des mois — couvrant Agentforce, la data, la plateforme et les architectures headless — et vos insights terrain alimenteront directement les équipes produit qui les développent.

  • Innovation continue : Vous devrez rester à la pointe, en expérimentant de nouveaux outils IA, modèles et frameworks, et en partageant vos apprentissages avec votre équipe et vos clients.



Ce que vous allez concrètement construire
 

  • Développer des agents IA et des expériences qui réalisent de vraies actions pour de vraies organisations. Nos solutions sont en production chez certaines des plus grandes entreprises mondiales. Ce travail a du sens parce que les clients en dépendent.

  • Concevoir l'intelligence des agents : prompts, raisonnement, appels d'outils et intégration avec les systèmes clients, en s'appuyant sur notre plateforme d'IA agentique et les techniques LLM actuelles.

  • Prendre en charge des composants techniques de bout en bout : du choix d'architecture jusqu'au déploiement, validé et observable en production.

  • Construire et intégrer des pipelines de données sur Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks et les plateformes de données clients. Modéliser la donnée, livrer le pipeline, valider les outputs.

  • Développer et maintenir des dashboards de performance des agents et des reportings KPI clients pour suivre la santé des déploiements et les résultats business.

  • Contribuer à des preuves de concept et des MVP qui passent de l'esquisse au déployable en jours, pas en mois.

  • Co-construire aux côtés des clients et partenaires, en partageant les meilleures pratiques et en les montant en compétences au fil des missions. Laisser les équipes plus capables après chaque engagement qu'avant.

  • Remonter les lacunes de la plateforme, cas limites et insights terrain aux ingénieurs seniors et à l'équipe produit. Votre expérience terrain est la boucle de feedback produit.

  • Travailler en binôme avec le Deployment Strategist de votre pod pour traduire les enjeux business clients en solutions agentiques qui livrent vraiment.



Vous êtes notre Forward Deployed Engineer si…
 

  • Vous avez 3+ ans d'expérience en ingénierie logicielle ou en delivery technique, avec au moins un système en production dont vous seriez fier de nous parler — idéalement dans une stack IA, du développement full-stack, ou avec des modèles frontier.

  • Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme en Informatique ou dans un domaine connexe.

  • Vous avez une expérience préalable en delivery technique orienté client (conseil, services professionnels ou forward deployed engineering) — c'est une exigence, pas un bonus.

  • Vous maîtrisez au moins un langage parmi Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java ou Apex — et êtes prêt à en ajouter d'autres selon les besoins.

  • Vous avez une expérience pratique des LLMs et du prompt engineering. Vous pouvez expliquer pourquoi un prompt a échoué et ce que vous changeriez.

  • Vous comprenez la modélisation de données, les APIs et les patterns d'intégration suffisamment en profondeur pour les concevoir, pas seulement les consommer.

  • Vous êtes à l'aise dans une salle avec des équipes commerciales et des architectes clients.

  • Vous livrez du code de qualité et évaluez les outputs IA avec la rigueur d'un ingénieur.

  • Vous explorez activement le paysage IA/data en évolution — en testant de nouveaux outils, en expérimentant de nouveaux modèles, et en restant sincèrement curieux de ce qui arrive.

  • Vous vous épanouissez dans le groupe de travail qui construit quelque chose, pas seulement qui en parle.

  • Vous êtes enthousiaste à l'idée de voyager ~25% du temps pour travailler directement aux côtés des clients.



Atouts supplémentaires
 

  • Expérience sur la plateforme Salesforce ou certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)

descriptionHtml:

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Salesforce brings customer data, CRM, analytics, and AI together on a trusted platform. Our teams help organizations turn complex business and data requirements into secure, scalable solutions. In this role, you will help customers put Data 360 into production and build the technical foundation for reliable, enterprise-grade use cases.

The Experience

Production implementation experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers focused on Data 360, Salesforce’s real-time data engine that unifies data from any source. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be a hands-on Technical Builder who configures, builds, tests, and deploys Data 360 directly inside enterprise customer environments. You will turn approved solution designs and acceptance criteria into working implementations across ingestion, harmonization, identity, insights, activation, retrieval, security, and operational readiness.

Data 360 is also the data foundation for Agentforce - and grounding agents in accurate, real-time enterprise data is deep data engineering. You'll go further into RAG, vector search, MCP, and agent-to-agent integration than most data roles ever touch, because the agents are only as good as the layer you build.

You'll work within a delivery team that includes architects, deployment strategists, Agentforce FDEs, account teams, and customer technical teams. Engagements may span a focused proof, production rollout, and stabilization. The common thread is real customer data, disciplined testing, and a supportable handoff.

This is a hands-on data and software engineering role. You will build in real enterprise customer environments - writing SQL, Python, and Apex; building ingestion pipelines; debugging identity resolution; and shipping working implementations from sandbox through production. If you're looking for a purely declarative configuration role or a pure advisory role, this isn't it.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Build in customer environments. Configure and develop directly in customer sandboxes and production - using Data 360 configuration, SQL, Apex, Flow, Python, the REST Query API, the Interaction SDK, Salesforce DX, CLI, Git, Data Kits, and deployment tooling as required - following security, change-management, and release controls.
  • Engineer the data layer. Build ingestion, harmonization, and identity resolution across batch and streaming sources. Materialize views of data optimized for specific application, analytical, and agentic workloads, tuning latency and cost tradeoffs to meet use-case requirements. Work with customer data and AI teams to ensure implementations align with their existing strategies (e.g., data mesh, data fabric).
  • Prove it works. Create representative test data and validate expected outcomes across happy paths, edge cases, access boundaries, hierarchy behavior, failure conditions, and customer-scale volumes.
  • Ground the agents. Design, build, and maintain the AI data integration layer - RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, search indexes, and knowledge bases - that grounds Agentforce solutions in accurate, real-time enterprise data.
  • Orchestrate agent communication. Design and implement the protocols - including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent communication - that govern, monitor, and ensure efficient collaboration among specialized AI agents.
  • Connect the ecosystem. Implement robust, scalable, and secure data integration patterns that connect Agentforce to a wide range of enterprise applications and enable communication between AI agents.
  • Govern the data. Apply deep data management expertise to ensure the secure integration, transformation, and governance of structured and unstructured data across the Salesforce ecosystem (CRM, Data Cloud) and external systems.
  • Build for scale and security. Apply knowledge of message queues, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems to build resilient workflows and implement secure authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth, SAML) so that all agent actions are secure and comply with enterprise security policies.
  • Debug the hard problems. Troubleshoot ingestion failures, mapping defects, schema drift, identity anomalies, query behavior, activation latency, API errors, permissions, and consumption issues - methodically, with logs and query evidence, isolating product behavior from configuration error.
  • Own implementation decisions. Compare viable techniques within the approved architecture, document measured tradeoffs, and recommend the most maintainable implementation to the responsible architect or technical lead.
  • Accelerate with AI. Use AI tooling - including Data 360 APIs and MCP Servers - to automate the build process and compress customers' time to value.
  • Co-build and hand off. Work alongside customer technical teams and partners through pairing, code reviews, and configuration reviews. Package reusable metadata, scripts, queries, tests, and runbooks so the solution can be reproduced and supported. Support deployment, validation, production handoff, and early stabilization, leaving clear ownership and known limitations.
  • Feed the roadmap. Surface reproducible platform gaps and edge cases - with live evidence, impact, and expected behavior - directly to Product and Support.

You're Our Person If....

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or technical implementation, including a production data solution you can explain in detail.
  • You have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • You have hands-on experience implementing Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud) or a comparable enterprise data platform across ingestion, modeling, identity, insight, activation, and operations.
  • You have hands-on experience building data pipelines and integrations using at least one enterprise data platform or technology, such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Kafka, cloud object storage, or an enterprise MDM platform.
  • You are proficient in SQL and can build, debug, and optimize multi-table queries, joins, filters, transformations, and validation checks.
  • You are fluent in at least one implementation language used in enterprise delivery - Apex, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript - and are willing to learn the others as needed.
  • You understand data modeling, APIs, integration patterns, batch and streaming processing, and the practical differences between copied, federated, and Zero Copy data access.
  • You've built retrieval systems for AI applications - vector databases, search indexes, embedding pipelines, or knowledge bases - and can explain the design decisions behind chunking, indexing, and relevance.
  • You've implemented secure service-to-service integration patterns (OAuth, SAML, event-driven architectures) and are conversant in emerging agent protocols like MCP and agent-to-agent communication.
  • You can implement secure data access and rigorously test it, including permissions, entitlements, consent, user context, restricted populations, and negative test cases.
  • You diagnose technical problems methodically, use logs and query evidence, isolate product behavior from configuration errors, and document a reproducible result.
  • You can implement against a documented architecture, explain what you built to customer technical teams, and recognize when a question requires an architect or security owner.
  • You have delivered alongside customers, partners, professional services, or internal implementation teams in deadline-driven environments.
  • You are excited to work directly with customer administrators, developers, data engineers, and architects.
  • You have relevant certifications in Salesforce Agentforce, Data 360, and the Salesforce Platform.

Join an agile team with deep startup roots. We operate as a high-velocity 'startup-within-Salesforce,' following our recent acquisition. You’ll be managed by the same founders and engineers who built the original company, offering the autonomy of a small team backed by the global scale and trust of Salesforce. You will have the unique opportunity to perfect the original  '0 to 1' product with the founding team, as we push towards an order-of-magnitude increase in the scale of our customer base. 

Global supply chains still rely on slow, manual processes—email, spreadsheets, and fragmented data. The economy moves fast but supply chains don’t, creating an inefficiency that affects the $13T of goods shipped annually and is one of the largest untapped opportunities in modern enterprise.

Agentforce Operations is reimagining the supply chain with an AI-powered platform for designing, automating, and orchestrating end-to-end business processes, with seamless collaboration through familiar channels like email and Slack. For Salesforce, this represents a major back-office growth opportunity, while also delivering innovations that enhance the existing front-office business. Customers are clamoring for more, rapidly expanding their use cases as we enter an exhilarating growth phase. As one user put it: “I’ve been waiting for this for 20 years.”

What you’ll do

You would be joining at an exciting inflection point in Agentforce Operations’ history. Our product was built with intentional startup speed that created tight coupling, limited observability, and reliability and scaling gaps that are now surfacing as customer adoption accelerates.

As a performance engineer for Agentforce Operations, your mandate will be to radically optimize the scalability, resilience, and performance of our product and platform across the entire stack to help usher in this next phase of growth. The ideal candidate would be able to develop a deep technical understanding of our architecture and then deliver the end-to-end implementation of optimizations that would enable us to achieve greater scalability while simultaneously improving our reliability. Agentforce Operations manages complex, infinitely configurable states with equally complex state transitions and interfaces to teams across the organization. That means you'd be tackling a wide array of challenges that would include optimization of our existing data model, streamlining of our asynchronous operations patterns, profiling and rightsizing our infrastructure, and developing both the tools and observability to run experiments and empirically validate results. 


You would be considered the subject matter expert in matters of application performance and as such you’d operate with meaningful autonomy while building alignment across engineering. This role comes with ample opportunity for advancement by raising the bar on system quality, leveling up the engineers around you, and ultimately accelerating us toward our ambitious scaling goals.


Responsibilities

  • Diagnose and prioritize architectural problems across our distributed backend systems, contributing technical perspective to help the team invest in the right foundational work at the right time
  • Design and implement solutions to hard system problems including application performance optimization, infrastructure management, and data model improvements. 
  • Raise and maintain our engineering quality bar through pragmatic standards, guardrails, and team practices that prevent regressions and keep our product healthy and performant. 
  • Collaborate with peers across customer, product, and engineering to deeply understand customer needs, make pragmatic tradeoffs that maximize impact, and align on engineering reality
  • Mentor engineers as a senior peer and force multiplier, sharing expertise across backend architecture and system design while helping shape stronger engineering judgment, more effective collaboration, and a higher-performing team

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience as a backend engineer, building and operating user-facing applications and their underlying infrastructure 
  • Mastery of Golang, GraphQL, and Postgres, with demonstrated experience delivering high-performance optimizations. 
  • Major public cloud provider experience (AWS preferred). 
  • Deep expertise in multiple areas of backend engineering such as data modeling, db performance tuning, state management, API design, transactionality, concurrency, memory management, fault tolerance, and scaling, with the ability to pick up new technologies quickly
  • Repeated ownership of foundational system work in complex distributed systems, from diagnosing architectural problems to designing solutions to driving adoption across a team. 
  • Excellent writing and speaking skills and ability to lead real-time technical-design discussions
  • Demonstrated ownership and accountability, with a consistent track record of high standards, continuous improvement, and low-ego collaboration

Preferred Qualifications

  • B.S. in Computer Science (M.S. preferred)
  • Experience working in AWS, specifically with RDS, Elasticache, S3, and EKS. 
  • Exposure to Temporal, Istio, or Typesense

  • Experience: 15+ years in product operations, program management, or platform strategy, with 5+ years in a senior leadership role driving cross-functional programs at scale.
  • Technical, Product & Platform Acumen: comprehensive knowledge of the Salesforce Platform, products, architecture, and technology ecosystem is required, with strong technical fluency across AI, automation, APIs, integrations, data, security, and product lifecycle management. Demonstrated ability to understand complex technical concepts, anticipate platform and product dependencies, assess customer and operational impact, and translate emerging technology into actionable readiness, supportability, and go-to-market strategies. Comfortable engaging deeply with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Customer Success leaders to influence technical and product decisions.
  • Program Leadership: Proven experience leading NPI and building scalable readiness and governance frameworks within large, complex organizations. Ability to establish operating models that span multiple products, teams, and clouds, with strong rigor around tracking, gating, prioritization, dependencies, and accountability from innovation through launch and adoption.
  • Process Redesign: Experience diagnosing and fixing upstream engagement gaps in cross-functional release/readiness processes — shifting a function from reactive, late-stage involvement to proactive, early engagement.
  • Security & Risk Fluency: Experience anticipating and mitigating the operational/support impact of security mandates and controls before they reach customers — balancing security urgency with support capacity.

Notre équipe Partner Cloud se consacrera spécifiquement à aider les entreprises qui s'appuient sur des canaux de vente indirects à optimiser la croissance de leur chiffre d'affaires grâce aux solutions Salesforce de gestion des relations partenaires (Partner Relationship Management - PRM, PRM+) et de gestion des revenus des canaux de vente (Channel Revenue Management - ChRM). Vous aurez l'opportunité de travailler au sein d'une équipe dynamique avec des clients variés, tout en bénéficiant de formations personnalisées et de belles perspectives d'évolution de carrière.

Ce rôle implique la vente de solutions de gestion des revenus des canaux de vente, incluant :

  • La gestion de l'écosystème de partenaires Salesforce (Partner Ecosystem Management - PEM, qui comprend le PRM, les parcours partenaires/Parcours Partenaires, les incitations unifiées, la planification des comptes, etc.)
  • La gestion des revenus des canaux de vente Salesforce (Channel Revenue Management - ChRM)
  • Les offres Cloud associées s'inscrivant dans la plateforme Customer 360, le cas échéant

Au quotidien

Nos Account Executives interagissent avec les clients existants ainsi qu'avec de nouveaux prospects pour vendre l'ensemble de la plateforme Salesforce Customer 360, en se focalisant particulièrement sur la croissance du chiffre d'affaires via les écosystèmes de partenaires et l'optimisation des opérations de vente indirecte. Ils construisent des relations solides et de confiance tant avec les collaborateurs clés qu'avec les dirigeants décisionnaires (C-Level) de leur secteur, et deviennent des experts pour aider les clients à mesurer la valeur de leurs investissements Salesforce. Les parties prenantes clés incluent notamment les Directeurs/VP des ventes indirectes, les Directeurs des partenariats, les Directeurs des Systèmes d'Information (DSI/CIO), les Directeurs Commerciaux (CRO), les responsables financiers, les Directeurs Financiers (CFO) et les responsables des remises et incitations (Rebate/Incentive Managers).


Vous mettrez à profit vos compétences pour développer des opportunités, tant à partir de prospects qualifiés que par de la prospection sur des comptes vierges (whitespace), en vous ciblant sur les entreprises qui vendent via des revendeurs, distributeurs, prestataires de services gérés (MSP), concessionnaires, courtiers indépendants ou agents. 75 % du commerce mondial passe par les canaux de vente indirects. Vos activités quotidiennes comprendront :

  • Le développement de relations clés avec les parties prenantes chez les clients et la maximisation de la satisfaction client sur les comptes attribués, en vous concentrant spécifiquement sur leurs ventes indirectes et leurs stratégies de partenariat.
  • L'élaboration et le pilotage de la stratégie globale à long terme pour le compte, alignée sur les objectifs commerciaux du client liés à l'optimisation des revenus des canaux de vente, à l'engagement des partenaires et à la rentabilité.
  • La coordination des ressources internes de Salesforce, comme les spécialistes en gestion des revenus des canaux de vente, pour répondre aux besoins métiers du client.
  • La planification stratégique sur les comptes attribués (account planning), en coordination avec les équipes de vente Prime et Cloud pour garantir un alignement stratégique sur les initiatives liées aux canaux de vente.
  • La mise en valeur de la proposition de valeur de Salesforce pour les solutions de gestion des revenus des canaux de vente, en mettant en avant des bénéfices tels que : la simplification de l'ensemble du cycle de vie des partenaires, la stimulation de la croissance de l'écosystème, la maximisation de la rentabilité, la simplification des flux de travail des partenaires grâce à l'automatisation, l'accélération de la collaboration en temps réel, l'amélioration de la productivité des partenaires, l'obtention d'une visibilité de bout en bout sur les stocks, incitations et prix des canaux de vente, ainsi que la maximisation des profits grâce à une gestion automatisée des remises.
  • La prise en charge des problématiques clients telles que : une stratégie partenaire inefficace, des difficultés à fidéliser les partenaires, des problèmes de routage des pistes commercialisables (leads), une mauvaise qualité des données impactant les transactions partenaires, des difficultés de communication avec les partenaires, des architectures technologiques complexes pour la gestion des canaux, des difficultés à engager efficacement les partenaires et une charge de travail administrative manuelle excessive.
  • Le pilotage de la croissance au sein des comptes existants attribués en identifiant des opportunités d'extension de l'utilisation des solutions PRM, PRM+ et ChRM.
  • L'utilisation des fonctionnalités d'IA de la plateforme pour démontrer sa valeur, notamment via le lead scoring (notation des pistes) et l'analyse du pipeline des partenaires.
  • Le positionnement de la solution Partner Tracks comme un module complémentaire pour les clients PRM existants afin d'optimiser la montée en compétences des partenaires, de développer et d'étendre le réseau de partenaires, et d'augmenter le chiffre d'affaires par canal.

Qualifications souhaitées :

  • Minimum 6 ans d'expérience dans la vente de cycle complet (full cycle sales) au sein d'environnements complexes et/ou SaaS.
  • Maîtrise courante du français à l'oral et à l'écrit, avec un excellent niveau d'anglais.
  • Capacité à élaborer des stratégies conjointement avec une grande équipe étendue.
  • Une expérience dans la vente auprès d'entreprises utilisant des canaux de vente indirects (revendeurs, distributeurs, concessionnaires, etc.) constitue un atout majeur.
  • Une expérience dans la vente de solutions CRM, PRM ou de gestion des canaux de vente est très vivement souhaitée.
  • Bonne compréhension des processus de vente indirecte, des programmes partenaires, des incitations, ainsi que des enjeux de stock et de tarification liés aux canaux indirects.
  • L'expérience sera évaluée sur la base des compétences clés liées au poste (ex. rôles de leadership extra-scolaires, expérience militaire, bénévolat, expérience professionnelle, etc.).

The Experience

Agentforce is Salesforce's next-generation AI platform, delivering autonomous agents that reason, take action, and communicate naturally across every customer touchpoint. Voice is the fastest-growing interaction surface—from contact-center automation and field-service assistants to real-time sales coaching and multilingual global deployments.

As Director of Agentforce Voice Models, you will own the full voice intelligence stack: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR / STT), Text-to-Speech (TTS), Speech-to-Speech (S2S) end-to-end pipelines, speaker diarization, prosody modeling, and the language-coverage roadmap that makes Agentforce sound natural in every market we serve. You will partner with product, infrastructure, and go-to-market teams to set the bar for transcription accuracy, latency, and voice expressiveness at enterprise scale.

At Salesforce, we believe AI agents will redefine how businesses and people work. Agentforce is at the center of that shift—and Voice is its most human interface. You will work at the intersection of frontier research and enterprise-grade reliability, with direct customer impact across 150,000+ organizations worldwide, with access to proprietary, enterprise-grade voice data, world-class compute, and a platform with distribution that no startup can match.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Define and own the multi-year roadmap for Agentforce voice capabilities, spanning ASR/STT, TTS, S2S, and real-time voice agents, including build vs. buy vs. partner decisions and setting accuracy, latency, and quality benchmarks (WER, MOS, RTF, DMOS).
  • Lead ASR/STT, neural TTS, and low-latency Speech-to-Speech (S2S) pipeline development—covering streaming recognition, prosody and persona design, and full-duplex conversational AI integrated with agent action loops.
  • Own speaker diarization, voice-biometric authentication, and the global language coverage and localization roadmap, including data governance and dialect/accent validation.
  • Recruit and lead a world-class team of research engineers, applied scientists, and ML engineers (target team size: 20–30), partnering cross-functionally with Product, Legal, Privacy, and Trust & Safety on voice AI ethics and compliance (HIPAA, PCI, GDPR), and representing Agentforce Voice externally at conferences and standards bodies (W3C, IETF).



You're Our Person If...

  • 10+ years in speech/audio machine learning, with 4+ years in a senior leadership role managing teams of 10 or more engineers or scientists.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in at least two of: ASR (end-to-end or hybrid CTC/attention architectures), neural TTS (VITS, Voicebox, Matcha-TTS, or equivalent), or real-time speech processing pipelines.
  • Proven track record of shipping production voice models at scale (millions of minutes per day) with measurable accuracy and latency improvements.
  • Proficiency in Python; experience with PyTorch or JAX model training at scale; familiarity with cloud-based training infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure).



Even Better If...

  • PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Linguistics, or related field with a speech/audio focus, or equivalent industry experience.
  • Familiarity with streaming inference, model quantization (INT8/INT4), and on-device deployment for low-latency voice.
  • Background in telephony protocols (SIP, RTP, WebRTC) and enterprise contact-center platforms (Genesys, NICE, Avaya, Amazon Connect).

The Forward Deployed Consultant owns a customer engagement end to end: from the executive business case, through rapid design and deployment of automated process solutions ("Blueprints") on the Agentforce platform, to a clean handoff to partners and client teams. You will advise enterprise leaders, quantify ROI, and map multi-year automation roadmaps.

You bring domain depth in supply chain, ERP, or finance operations processes, including where people patch over system gaps.

You will also roll up your sleeves to build, test, and iterate Blueprints with AI agents and prompting tools, proving value fast in live production.

You are customer-obsessed, strategic, and execution-focused, with the speed and quality to turn fragmented manual workflows into scalable, value-driven solutions.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Serve as the primary strategic advisor to enterprise stakeholders, building a deep understanding of business goals and operational pain points.
  • Build business cases and define success criteria up front: KPIs such as cycle time and cost per transaction, with a measured baseline.
  • Own multi-year roadmaps for process Blueprints and automation, balancing strategic direction with near-term execution.
  • Present to executives in terms of their priorities; flag when work is off track early and plainly, with a fix, and drive to a decision.
  • Lead structured discovery (workshops, process maps) and turn it into a solution design and a first working version in days to weeks.
  • Automate business processes end to end (procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, supplier onboarding), deciding what stays in the ERP, what is automated around it, and what AI decides versus people.

  • Translate strategic goals into clear PRDs and technical acceptance criteria.
  • Deliver in continuous build loops (design, build, validate, refine), where each loop proves value and expands scope toward AI-first operations.
  • Lead an AI-first delivery experience, using AI agents and skills to accelerate requirements, build, testing, and documentation.
  • Own delivery end to end through go-live: scoping, build, UAT, data migration, and cutover, managing scope change along the way.

  • Design and run handoff processes, documentation, and enablement that transition ownership to implementation partners and customer teams.
  • Set handoff guidelines, solution architecture documentation, and success criteria for sustained post-deployment success.

  • 5+ years in Solutions Consulting, Forward Deployed roles, Strategic or Management Consulting, Product Management, Process Automation, or Business Analysis.

  • Proven track record owning engagements from discovery through go-live (UAT, data migration, cutover), not just POCs, followed by structured handoffs.
  • Strong grounding in workflow mapping, process modeling, process improvement, and change management.
  • Experience translating business requirements into automated workflows, PRDs, and user stories.
  • Working knowledge of integration patterns (REST, SOAP, event-based) and common risks such as auth, latency, and payload limits.
  • Track record of setting success KPIs and baselines up front and measuring outcomes after go-live.

  • 結合策略規劃及落地執行：作為顧問或主要合作夥伴（Prime Vendor）的角色，參與具代表性的轉型專案，從前期策略規劃到實際導入上線，協助客戶將轉型藍圖落實為可執行的成果。
  • 應用前沿 AI 技術：協助客戶評估與導入 Agentforce 等新一代 AI 解決方案。使用各式 AI 工具，提升分析深度、設計品質與交付效率。
  • 端到端 (End-to-End) 參與：從願景規劃、架構設計到上線後的落地運行與持續優化，參與專案各個關鍵階段，累積完整且具深度的實戰經驗。


主要角色類型
依據您的專業背景，入職後將主要參與以下其中一類角色：

  • PM (Project Manager/Engagement Delivery Manager)：負責專案規劃、進度推動與交付管理。
  • BA (Business Architect)：負責商業策略、流程設計與應用推廣。
  • SA (Solution Architect)：負責整體解決方案、資料模型與多雲架構設計。
  • TA (Technical Architect)：負責技術架構、系統整合、資安與效能優化。


What You'll Actually Be Doing
本職位將根據專案需求及您的專業領域，參與以下各階段的任務：

  • A. 戰略與轉型設計 (Strategy & Change Design)：負責制定組織及系統整體的轉型構想與藍圖。組織與業務領域轉型設計：策劃業務流程改革及組織變革的整體架構。規劃組織與業務流程轉型方向，協助客戶建立整體藍圖。系統領域轉型設計：設計企業 IT 架構與 Salesforce 平台發展策略。Salesforce Org 戰略：制定 Salesforce Org（Instance）的活用戰略、治理戰略及發展藍圖規劃 Salesforce Org 的治理模式、使用策略與長期發展方向。Salesforce CTO 顧問：從企業架構或 CTO 顧問角度，協助客戶推動 AI 與數位轉型。變革推動與應用推廣落地：規劃變革管理與推動方案，應用推廣，提升解決方案導入後的落地成效。概念驗證 (PoC)：參與 PoC 設計與驗證，評估方案可行性。
  • B. 專案執行與支援 (Project Execution & Support)：從需求定義到上線發佈，在各階段提供支援或執行實務工作。根據專案特性選擇瀑布式（Waterfall）或敏捷式（Agile）開發。專案管理：參與專案規劃、進度推動與執行管理。需求定義：進行需求訪談、需求分析與流程引導。設計：主導或參與應用設計、架構設計與詳細設計，並審查相關成果。開發與測試：領導實作與測試工作，或制定開發標準及品質管理流程。遷移與部署：執行資料遷移與部署上線，或制定遷移策略並支援執行。CI/CD：協助建立開發標準，開發環境設計、構建與運維等 DevOps 流程。
  • C. 治理與最佳化 (Governance & Optimization)Salesforce 治理 (Governance)：協助建立 Salesforce 治理機制與 CoE (Center of Excellence) 運作模式。設計權威 (Design Authority)：建立或參與設計審查與架構治理流程，確保設計品質。設計品質最佳實踐 (Best Practice)：提供設計最佳實務與優化建議，提升專案交付品質。架構最佳化 (Architecture Optimization)：針對既有環境進行 Org 健檢、架構診斷與最佳化建議。



You're Our Person If...

  • 實務經驗：在以下任一領域具備 7 年以上的實務經驗，並曾擔任主要推動角色：A. 策略規劃與轉型設計 (Strategy & Change Design)；B. 治理與持續優化 (Governance & Optimization)；C. 專案推動與執行 (Project Execution & Support)
  • 領導力：具備 3 年以上團隊帶領或專案領導經驗（職稱不限）。
  • 溝通能力：能與客戶高階主管（含C-Level）及相關利害關係人進行有效溝通，推動共識形成與專案進展。
  • 溝通能力：具備良好的跨部門及跨角色溝通與協作能力，能與不同成員有效合作。
  • 學習及理解力：能快速理解業務需求、Salesforce 相關技術概念及專案方法
  • 學習及理解力：具備學習新技術的意願與行動力，並願意善用 AI 工具提升工作效率與產出品質
  • 核心思維：具備實踐「批判性思考 (Critical Thinking)」與「歸零學習 (Unlearning)」的能力。
  • 核心思維：不過度執著於過去的成功經驗，能針對 AI 等新技術靈活調整自身的思考模式與方法論。
  • 語言能力：中文：母語等級。
  • 語言能力：英文：商務英文溝通能力。



Even Better If...

  • AI 與數據領域實務經驗：具備 AI、資料應用、資料治理或 AI Agent 相關專案經驗。
  • 全球化專案執行能力：具備以英文進行專案溝通與跨國協作的實務經驗。
  • 運用 AI 提升業務效率之績效：曾在顧問服務或系統建置過程中，實際運用 AI 工具提升工作效率或交付品質。
  • 認證：具備 Salesforce 相關認證者佳，如 Application Architect 或 System Architect等



本職位提供的職涯價值

  • 成長為全方位架構師： 透過參與不同階段的轉型專案，累積策略規劃、架構設計、專案交付與治理優化等完整實務經驗。
  • 拓展 AI 與 CRM 專業能力： 持續接觸 AI 與 CRM 領域的最新趨勢與技術應用，拓展專業深度與職涯發展空間。
  • 累積關鍵轉型專案歷練： 透過參與具挑戰性與代表性的客戶專案，強化架構判斷、跨部門協作與專案推動能力。
  • 發展多元職涯方向： 我們將依據您的專業背景、職涯方向與個人特質，提供合適的發展機會與成長舞台。

The Experience
We are looking for passionate, forward-thinking partners who want to help customers with digital transformation and business process optimization. You will lead the full journey, from enterprise system vision and strategy through to actual implementation and live operation, guiding customers and teams to use the Salesforce platform to achieve their business vision and goals. You will also keep getting exposure to the latest AI and CRM trends and technologies, expanding your professional capabilities and career boundaries.

Role Highlights

  • Strategy and execution combined: As a consultant or Prime Vendor, take part in representative transformation projects, from early-stage strategic planning through to go-live, helping customers turn their transformation blueprint into actionable results.
  • Apply cutting-edge AI: Help customers evaluate and adopt next-generation AI solutions such as Agentforce. Use a range of AI tools to improve analytical depth, design quality, and delivery efficiency.
  • End-to-end involvement: Take part in every key project phase, from vision planning and architecture design to post-launch operation and continuous optimization, building complete and in-depth hands-on experience.



Role Types
Based on your background, after joining you will mainly take on one of the following roles:

  • PM (Project Manager/Engagement Delivery Manager): Responsible for project planning, driving progress, and delivery management.
  • BA (Business Architect): Responsible for business strategy, process design, and adoption.
  • SA (Solution Architect): Responsible for the overall solution, data model, and multi-cloud architecture design.
  • TA (Technical Architect): Responsible for technical architecture, system integration, security, and performance optimization.



What You'll Actually Be Doing
Depending on project needs and your area of expertise, you will take part in tasks across the following phases:

  • A. Strategy & Change Design: Define the overall transformation vision and blueprint for the organization and its systems.Organization and business transformation design: Plan the overall framework for business process reform and organizational change. Plan the direction of organizational and process transformation and help customers build the overall blueprint.System transformation design: Design the enterprise IT architecture and Salesforce platform development strategy.Salesforce Org strategy: Define the utilization strategy, governance strategy, and development roadmap for the Salesforce Org (Instance), including its governance model, usage strategy, and long-term direction.Salesforce CTO advisory: Help customers drive AI and digital transformation from an enterprise architecture or CTO advisor perspective.Change enablement and adoption: Plan change management and enablement programs and drive adoption to improve results after the solution is introduced.Proof of Concept (PoC): Take part in PoC design and validation to assess solution feasibility.
  • B. Project Execution & Support: Provide support or hands-on work at every stage, from requirements definition to release. Waterfall or Agile development is chosen based on the nature of the project.Project management: Take part in project planning, driving progress, and execution management.Requirements definition: Conduct requirements interviews, requirements analysis, and process facilitation.Design: Lead or take part in application design, architecture design, and detailed design, and review related deliverables.Development and testing: Lead implementation and testing, or define development standards and quality management processes.Migration and deployment: Carry out data migration and deployment to production, or define the migration strategy and support its execution.CI/CD: Help establish development standards and DevOps processes such as development environment design, build, and operations.
  • C. Governance & OptimizationSalesforce Governance: Help establish Salesforce governance mechanisms and the operating model of a CoE (Center of Excellence).Design Authority: Establish or take part in design review and architecture governance processes to ensure design quality.Design quality best practices: Provide design best practices and optimization recommendations to improve project delivery quality.Architecture Optimization: Run Org health checks, architecture diagnostics, and optimization recommendations for existing environments.


You're Our Person If...

  • Hands-on experience: 7+ years of hands-on experience in any one of the following areas, having served in a main driving role: A. Strategy & Change Design; B. Governance & Optimization; C. Project Execution & Support
  • Leadership: 3+ years of experience leading teams or projects (title not required).
  • Communication: Able to communicate effectively with customer senior executives (including C-level) and relevant stakeholders, building consensus and moving projects forward.
  • Communication: Strong cross-department and cross-role communication and collaboration skills, able to work effectively with different members.
  • Learning and comprehension: Able to quickly understand business needs, Salesforce-related technical concepts, and project methodologies
  • Learning and comprehension: Willing and proactive in learning new technologies, and willing to use AI tools to improve efficiency and output quality
  • Core mindset: Able to practice critical thinking and unlearning.
  • Core mindset: Not overly attached to past successes, and able to flexibly adjust your thinking and methodology for new technologies such as AI.
  • Language: Chinese: native level.
  • Language: English: business-level communication skills.


Even Better If...

  • AI and data experience: Experience in projects involving AI, data applications, data governance, or AI agents.
  • Global project execution: Hands-on experience with project communication and cross-border collaboration in English.
  • Results from using AI to improve efficiency: Have actually used AI tools to improve efficiency or delivery quality in consulting services or system implementation.
  • Certifications: Salesforce-related certifications preferred, such as Application Architect or System Architect.


What This Role Offers for Your Career

  • Grow into a full-spectrum architect: Build complete hands-on experience in strategic planning, architecture design, project delivery, and governance optimization by taking part in transformation projects at different stages.
  • Expand AI and CRM expertise: Keep up with the latest trends and applications in AI and CRM to deepen your expertise and widen your career path.
  • Build experience on key transformation projects: Strengthen architectural judgment, cross-department collaboration, and project leadership through challenging, representative customer projects.
