title: Mulesoft Integration Senior Architect- Missionforce
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

As an Integration Technical Architect, be a subject-matter expert and mentor within MuleSoft Professional Services, driving enterprise-grade hybrid integration, API management, and infrastructure strategies for key customers, while coaching internal teams.

Missionforce's Professional Services team works across every technology and system to deliver solutions to customers in every industry. As an Integration Solution Architect on our Services team, you will enable customers to understand and employ MuleSoft technology hands-on while coaching and mentoring elite members of a fast-paced, growing organization. You will develop solutions to help customers realize their business goals and advise them on best practices for on-premise, cloud, and hybrid integration, and API management. The role requires you to be an influencer and thought leader with in-depth technical expertise, credibility, and field experience to establish yourself as a subject-matter expert in a company leading innovation within the integration services industry.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Lead and govern the design of complex, multi-phased MuleSoft integration projects, ensuring adherence to API-led connectivity and integration patterns.
  • Identify opportunities and efficiencies in customers IT operating model, and support implementation of the SDLC pipeline to get greater value out of the MuleSoft platform.
  • Define and scale enterprise integration best practices, reference architectures, foundational assets, and API patterns to drive platform adoption and reuse.
  • Establish and enforce DevOps models, CI/CD pipelines, and operational standards, including monitoring, alerting, and full API lifecycle management.
  • Scale best practices globally through reusable assets, reference architectures, and implementations.
  • Enable field teams and partners to boost delivery and customer success.
  • Lead requirements workshops and deliver architectural blueprint documents to influence the strategic direction of projects.
  • Guide product direction and feature delivery by identifying gaps and providing valuable insights to leadership.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to client executives and internal sales/delivery teams throughout the pre-sales and project delivery lifecycle.
  • Mentor and coach junior architects, engineers, and consultants on technical design principles, implementation strategies, and customer-facing best practices.
  • Drive decision-making for complex technical challenges, balancing scope, time-to-market, and technical debt across integration solutions.
  • Engage with MuleSoft Product Management and Engineering to relay field feedback and influence the platform's future roadmap.


You're Our Person If...

  • 10+ years of IT experience with 5+ years leading complex integration and solution architecture initiatives.
  • 2+ years of hands-on MuleSoft experience or similar experience, including proficiency in designing and implementing API-led connectivity and integration patterns.
  • Demonstrated expertise in High Availability (HA), Scalability, the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), and full API lifecycle management.
  • Demonstrated expertise in architecting, implementing, and supporting enterprise-grade technical solutions meeting complex business requirements while evangelizing integration methodologies and supporting business case justification to C-level executives.
  • Experience defining full API life-cycle management, from API design and integration development through to deployment, operations and governance.
  • Exceptional customer-facing communication and expectation management skills, including the ability to translate complex technical requirements into appropriate solution architectures and deliverables.
  • Demonstrated experience managing and architecting for multiple technical integration projects using the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) end-to-end, sometimes simultaneously
  • Demonstrated experience architecting services integrations with MuleSoft and the other solutions (e.g., IBM, BEA, Oracle Fusion, TIBCO, Dell Boomi, Progress Sonic, API Management solutions, etc.)
  • Demonstrated understanding of API security principles, including authentication, authorization, and the application of security policies
  • Qualification for this job is contingent upon acceptable results from a background investigation and your obtaining and maintaining the specific level of U.S. Government security clearance required for this role. U.S. citizenship (U.S. born or naturalized) required.



Even Better If...

  • Active Secret level security clearance
  • Integration and Architecture: Expertise in defining full API lifecycle management, SDLC, Microservices, and related architecture patterns (Service Mesh, Serverless).
  • MuleSoft Platform Mastery: Deep experience designing API-led connectivity and architecture (System, Process, Experience APIs) and mastery of MuleSoft Anypoint Platform features (e.g., API Management, Exchange, Flex Gateway).
  • Technical Workshops: Experience driving technical workshops with technical and business clients to derive value added services and implementations.
  • Security and Compliance: Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, FISMA, HIPAA, SOX), experience configuring enterprise software for security compliance, and desired certifications (CKA, CISSP, CISM, or Security+).
  • Cloud and DevOps: Multi-cloud proficiency (AWS, Azure, GCP) and expertise in DevOps practices (Git, Ansible, Terraform, Jenkins, CI/CD), including implementing multiple technical integration project SDLCs end-to-end.
  • Networking and Infrastructure: Working knowledge of on-premise/cloud/containerized-based infrastructures, SDLC pipelines, deployments/configurations, and definition/evangelism of best practices/standards. Includes extensive experience with Internet technologies (TCP/IP, HTTP, VPN, DNS, SSL/TLS) and load balancing products (AWS ELB/ALB/NLB, F5, Nginx, or HAproxy).
  • Programming and Data: Proficiency in at least two of the following: Bash, Go, Python, Ruby, node.js, Rust, Java. Working knowledge of at least one RDBMS (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server, Oracle DB), NoSQL (Cassandra, MongoDB), distributed key-value store (e.g. etcd), and Time-series DB (InfluxDB, TSDB).
This candidate must be a U.S. citizen (U.S. born or naturalized) who does not hold dual citizenship and agrees to complete a U.S. federal government Minimum Background Investigation (MBI) for a Moderate Public Trust position.

Overview:
Have you ever attended a Salesforce event or watched one of our keynotes on Salesforce+ and been wowed by the product demonstrations? That's our team, and we're hiring!
The Demo Team is looking for a Software Engineer who will inspire the team to push the boundaries of enterprise software and create the never before seen. You are passionate about technology and developing digital and physical experiences.
In your role as an innovator Senior Software Engineer, your day-to-day will consist of creating visually engaging and innovative demos, mentoring junior developers, and leading small teams in development and processes. You will complement the digital experience with tactile elements. This position requires someone who has great technical understanding as well as interpersonal skills to work with many different departments within the company. You’ll spend time with product teams designing and prototyping future features and product launches of Salesforce products. You're naturally curious and experiment with technologies like AI, robotics, image processing, beacons, AR, blockchain and more. We're always looking at how to push Salesforce products to empower people to solve more of the world's challenges.
Join our team of dreamers & doers and get ready to create high quality, interactive product visions that will be experienced by customers, business leaders and technologists all around the world.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner closely with product marketers, demo architects, and designers to understand the product strategy and distill key functionality and benefits into engaging demo experiences
  • Develop innovative and compelling/palpable stories and demonstrations that showcase the power of Salesforce
  • Ideate and build prototypes for important Salesforce product launches
  • Own the architecture of software prototypes and physical experiences for all major Salesforce keynotes
  • Wake up everyday thinking about how we tell more engaging stories that include tactile experiences in our event keynotes & campground and the Salesforce Innovation Center
  • Keep current with technology trends. Understand how emerging technology can be incorporated into our keynotes
  • Management of vendors as needed

Event Delivery & Live Demo Support

  • Own demo technical readiness for keynote events including rehearsals, code freezes, and live show support
  • Manage demo stability across multiple devices and presentation formats (stage screens, iPads, mobile devices)
  • Coordinate deployment timing and environment locks to ensure zero critical failures on stage
  • Create Demo Setup Guides (DSGs), clickpath documentation, and driving guides for speaker preparation
  • Optimize display settings and UI treatments for large-venue legibility (opacity transitions, screen bezels, resolution standards)
  • Support speakers during rehearsals and provide technical coaching on demo execution

Basic Qualifications:

  • 2+ years industry experience
  • Expertise in front-end development (HTML, CSS, Javascript), Salesforce Expertise is consider a good add (Must)
  • Experience with modern Javascript technologies such as: Angular, React, Vue, Node etc.
  • Experience with Java, Python or similar lenguages
  • Familiarity with tools such as Git, Heroku, and AWS
  • Driven, self-motivated, and flexible team player with proven ability to lead/inspire through influence
  • Creative thinker that can generate innovative ideas and lead a cross-functional team to drive execution
  • A proven track record in the design, development and delivery of creative and engineering concepts
  • Experience implementing from concept to production through field installation for small to medium projects

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner equally with Product Marketing Managers and Designers within your working group — you share ownership of demo success
  • Build deep relationships with Salesforce product engineering teams to stay ahead of feature availability, GA timelines, and known limitations
  • Coordinate with production teams (show callers, video directors, AV specialists) on technical integration and timing
  • Communicate proactively with stakeholders about build status, risks, and tradeoffs — especially when live stage demos require explicit escalation to product teams
  • Collaborate with localization teams for multi-language and multi-market demo delivery

Technical Strategy & Innovation

  • Evaluate emerging Salesforce features and recommend which to showcase in upcoming demos
  • Make architectural decisions about build approaches: real product vs. mocked, single-org vs. multi-org, live vs. static
  • Contribute to the team's proof pattern library covering core enterprise scenarios
  • Contribute to the teams enablement and distribution documentation for SE and global events
  • Drive continuous improvement in demo stability, build efficiency, and technical quality
  • Partner with development team members on complex builds

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with live product demonstrations for large audiences (conferences, keynotes, executive briefings, or webinars)
  • Experience with Slack platform development (Slack apps, Slackbot skills, workspace administration, federation)
  • Knowledge of Tableau integration and data visualization
  • Ability to turn high fidelity designs into functional prototypes using HTML/HTML5, CSS/CSS3, Javascript
  • Experience developing on the Salesforce platform (Aura, Apex, Lightning Web Components, Salesforce Administration etc.) - MUST
  • Experience with Salesforce unit testing and package management - MUST
  • Experience developing user interfaces in non-traditional formats such large format screens, car dashboards, AR/VR etc.
  • Strong object orient programming background
  • Familiarity with backend development concepts such as creating servers, REST APIs, and microservices
  • Familiarity with iOS, xCode, and Swift development
  • Experience designing, specifying, integrating, and testing cutting edge hardware with software APIs
  • Collaborate and communicate on multiple, complex projects concurrently, with a team of designers, developers and marketers from concept to completion


What Makes This Role Unique
This is not a typical Software Engineer position. Here's what sets it apart:

  • Audience: Your work is presented live to tens of thousands at Dreamforce, World Tours, and Salesforce's highest-profile moments — not in a boardroom or a sandbox
  • Breadth: You'll build across the entire Salesforce ecosystem in a single quarter
  • Creativity: You're not implementing requirements — you're co-creating the story, designing the experience, and making technical decisions that serve narrative impact
  • Speed: Build cycles are measured in weeks, not months — you'll prototype, iterate, and ship faster than anywhere else at Salesforce
  • Visibility: Your demos are built with and delivered by Salesforce leadership
  • Innovation: You'll be among the first to work with unreleased features and shape how the world first sees new Salesforce capabilities
  • Impact: When done right, your demos don't just impress — they become the reference architecture that customers and partners adopt


Additional Information

  • Travel: At least 33% (major events including Dreamforce, World Tours, product launches)

The CSM is responsible for identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, aligning them strategically with customer priorities, projects, and goals.


This is an Individual Contributor position.


Your Impact

Customer Accountability and Value Alignment

  • Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
  • Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle.
  • Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
  • Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
  • Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
  • Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.
  • Conduct enablement sessions on opportunity and case management, forecasting, pipeline hygiene, knowledge creation, and omni-channel routing.
  • Share best practices for sales and service process optimization, data quality, and customer experience.

Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management

  • Drive adoption of Sales and Service Cloud features with reps, agents, managers, supervisors, and ops teams.
  • Track usage metrics (opportunity updates, activity logging, forecast submissions, report usage, case resolution times, knowledge article usage, channel adoption, and CSAT scores).
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer's business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
  • Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
  • Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
  • Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.
  • Conduct quarterly reviews of feature usage to drive adoption of tools like Journey Builder or Commerce Promotions, ensuring platform stability and performance.
  • Identify underutilization of contracted entitlements (e.g., messaging volume or GMV tiers) and align platform features with customer priorities to increase throughput.

Technical Health, Adoption, and Risk Management

  • Drive adoption of Tableau features with business users and analysts and track usage metrics (active users, workbook views, data source adoption).
  • Conduct enablement sessions and share best practices on dashboard creation and performance, data exploration, and visualization design.
  • Escalate complex data modeling or server configuration questions to technical resources.
  • AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.
  • Prompt Engineering Basics: Ability to use natural-language commands to guide AI agents in retrieving accurate customer data and generating first drafts of success plans.
  • AI Engagement Monitoring: Use AI-driven sentiment and intent analysis to flag early customer concerns for human intervention.
  • Collaborative Learning: Actively seek out Agentblazer training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.
  • Learning & Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask effective diagnostic questions, and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.
  • Proactively monitor and conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
  • Serve as the primary interface for major incidents (e.g., checkout failures or email deliverability drops) to protect peak revenue.
  • Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
  • Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision-making.
  • Escalate complex automation, data model, routing, or integration questions to technical resources.

Minimum Requirements:

  • 5+ years of relevant industry expertise in Customer Success, SaaS platform use, or related fields.

The Experience

You are customer-obsessed and serve as the strategic partner and point of accountability for the success of our most complex MuleSoft enterprise customers. You have a deep curiosity to learn customers’ unique culture, business processes, and integration challenges in order to tailor the best possible customer success program for their needs. Unlike traditional software where value is unlocked at implementation, MuleSoft value is realized through continuous adoption, optimization of integration architectures, and expansion of API-led connectivity across the enterprise.

You maintain a relentless focus on your customers’ business goals, partnering to ensure a smooth transition from implementation to long-term value realization. You act as the voice of the customer internally, partnering cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Sales to drive high adoption, satisfaction, retention, and expansion.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for orchestration, value realization, adoption, and expansion.
  • Orchestrate the Relationship: Serve as the strategic partner for the customer, collaborating during the implementation phase to ensure seamless transition to adoption and long term value realization of integration and API initiatives.
  • Drive Adoption and Consumption: Proactively manage and maintain the roadmap for platform adoption. Drive optimization of API usage, integration patterns, and automation aligned to the customer’s digital transformation goals to ensure they’re getting full value from their investment.
  • Demonstrate ROI: Define, track, and demonstrate quantifiable business impact and ROI. Move the conversation from API calls to value (e.g., process automation gains, operational efficiency, faster time-to-market) to drive long-term value realization.
  • Executive Relationships: Represent Salesforce with expertise and credibility, partnering with and presenting to senior client executives (CIOs, CTOs, Enterprise Architects) and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Identify New Use Cases: Proactively scout the customer’s business to identify new integration opportunities and use cases that align with business objectives and drive additional platform adoption.
  • Remove Barriers and Manage Risk: Act as the primary orchestrator to proactively identify and minimize risks, remove blockers for adoption, and anticipate obstacles before they impact customer success. Address technical hurdles, architecture questions, and business process friction that prevents scaling of integration capabilities across the enterprise.
  • Drive Expansion: Build the business case for expanding MuleSoft footprint across additional business units, use cases, and integration patterns. Partner with the Sales team to secure renewals and drive expansion of the contract.
  • Voice of the Customer: Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Services to represent customer feedback and critical issues with a focus on outcomes, not just escalation.
  • Partner with Customer Architects: Ensure the integration architecture and API strategy is optimized to support increased connectivity, reusability, and scalability, preventing technical debt from throttling expansion.
  • Champion Center for Enablement: Act as a trusted advisor. Build and nurture a Center for Enablement (C4E) within the customer organization to drive bottom-up adoption, governance best practices, and peer-to-peer advocacy of API-led connectivity.
  • Commercial Strategy and Lead Generation: Act as the primary engine for growth. You are responsible for identifying signals that indicate a customer is ready for contract upsell and partnering with Sales to build the business case for increased investment.



You're Our Person If...

  • Work experience in Customer Success, Enterprise Sales, Professional Services, Technology Consulting, or SaaS platform implementation with demonstrated expertise in integration technologies.
  • Proven success managing large, complex enterprise accounts with multiple stakeholders and business units
  • Established ability to develop relationships with senior executives (Director/VP level) and influence technical strategy
  • Deeper technical knowledge of integration architectures, API design patterns, and platform best practices
  • Demonstrated history of driving incremental Annual Contract Value (iACV) through expansion sales
  • Integration Platform Experience: Experience with MuleSoft and/or relevant competing Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) platforms with understanding of API-led connectivity, system integration patterns, and enterprise architecture principles.
  • Adoption and Expansion Mindset: Proven track record of driving platform adoption, managing complex enterprise accounts, and identifying expansion opportunities within existing customer relationships.
  • Strategic Problem Solving: A strategic, customer centric approach to problem solving focused on driving business value and outcomes, not just resolving technical issues.
  • Communication: Exceptional communication and presentation skills with proven ability to translate technical concepts into business terms and partner with senior client executives from IT teams to C-level.
  • Project Management: Strong orchestration and project management skills, including scope control, stakeholder alignment, timeline ownership, and executive-ready reporting.
  • Agility: Demonstrated ability to thrive in fast paced, high growth environments, with willingness to wear multiple hats and confidence challenging norms to drive customer outcomes.



Even Better If...

  • MuleSoft Certifications: MuleSoft Certified Integration Foundations, MuleSoft Certified Platform Architect, MuleSoft Catalyst Consultant, or Salesforce AI Associate certifications are a strong plus.
  • Technical Background: Experience with software development processes, design methodologies, APIs, web services, databases, cloud platforms, and modern integration patterns.
  • Consulting Experience: Background in management consulting services with track record leading cross-functional teams to facilitate resolution of complex business and technical challenges.
  • Expansion Track Record: Proven history of uncovering new opportunities within existing accounts and partnering with Sales to close expansion revenue. Experience with ‘Land and Expand’ account strategies.
  • Industry Context: Experience working with Enterprise level customers across industries requiring complex integration strategies (Financial Services, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing, etc.).
  • AI and Agent Technologies: Foundational understanding of AI and agent technologies. Awareness of how AI capabilities can enhance automation, improve customer experiences, and drive business value through intelligent workflows. Curiosity and willingness to learn how AI augments traditional integration approaches.



Note: this role is office-flexible, and the expectation is to be in-office a minimum of three (3) days per week.

Role Summary

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment. This role functions as an extension of the customer’s workforce and a trusted advisor, bridging the gap between traditional CRM operations and modern digital marketing strategies.
The ideal candidate possesses a strong foundation in Salesforce Core (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Data Cloud) combined with deep experience in Digital Marketing. A key focus of this role will be guiding customers in the adoption of Salesforce Marketing Cloud (MC) Next and related personalization strategies, ensuring seamless data flow, segmentation, and activation across the Salesforce ecosystem. The CSM is responsible for identifying and addressing technical and business concerns, aligning them strategically with customer digital transformation priorities.

Your Impact

Customer Accountability and Value Alignment

  • Single Point of Accountability: Serve as the main point of customer accountability for the delivery of Signature deliverables, driving overall platform adoption, and ensuring successful renewals.
  • Bridge CRM and Marketing: Act as the strategic link between the customer's IT/Sales teams and Marketing departments, ensuring that Core CRM data effectively fuels digital marketing initiatives and MC Next capabilities.
  • Value Realization: Apply proven methodologies to address customer needs, ensuring measurable value is delivered through personalized customer journeys and unified data strategies.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Align and collaborate with both Business (Marketing, Sales) and Technical stakeholders to connect platform capabilities with campaign and revenue goals.

Strategic Accountability and Account Execution

  • ROI-Driven Engagement: Engage clients based on calculated ROI, ensuring all technical enablement and digital marketing workflow optimizations translate directly into tangible business value.
  • Data-Driven Strategy: Drive the Signature experience by helping customers leverage unified profiles and segmentation strategies (via Data Cloud and MC Next) to power multi-channel marketing.

descriptionHtml:

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

GTMA Trust - Full-Stack Software Engineer – PMTS


Join our dynamic team at Salesforce and make a real impact!


GTMA Trust engineers keep Digital Wallet — the product that lets customers manage, budget, and track usage entitlements across their Salesforce investment — reliable at scale. This is a follow-the-sun team that doesn't just monitor and fix; it owns the operational, technical, and data-integrity backbone underneath a live billing/usage platform where mistakes have direct revenue and customer-trust consequences. As a PMTS, you set the technical direction for how the team protects that trust — architecture, tooling, governance, and the practices that let a small trust org support a much larger surface area.

As a PMTS on this team, you will:

  • Own and drive resolution of the most complex, ambiguous, highest-impact production issues — spanning provisioning, billing/usage pipelines, and cross-org data reconciliation (data lake objects, usage/entitlement records tied to tenant billing,  mismatches, tenant provisioning, sandbox-vs-prod attributions) — going beyond triage into systemic root cause and org-wide fixes.
  • Act as a technical gatekeeper and escalation authority for high-risk production changes: knowing when a "point fix" needs a real rollback path instead of repeat manual sign-off.
  • Set the technical direction for service health: define what "critical signal" means, design instrumentation/alerting/dashboard strategy, and drive Ops Review reporting that leadership and partner teams rely on.
  • Identify and lead multi-quarter structural fixes — including auto-detect-and-fix tooling that eliminates recurring manual interventions — rather than accumulating one-off patches.
  • Act as the technical anchor during major incidents and cross-team escalations (including revenue- or deal-critical customer situations), representing GTMA Trust on incident bridges and negotiating shared-issue closure with partner teams like Data360
  • Build and maintain the team's institutional knowledge: root-cause catalogues, runbooks, and enablement docs that let any engineer — not just tenured ones — resolve recurring classes of issues correctly.

Additionally, you will:

  • Partner at a peer level with product engineering's senior technical leadership, shaping roadmap and design decisions before they're finalized.
  • Be the primary technical voice and SME representing GTMA Trust to Product and partner engineering teams.
  • Define and evolve the team's development process, culture, and codebase standards.
  • Set the bar for the hybrid engineering model — quality and completeness of work, not just velocity.
  • Mentor and grow engineers in technologies, tools, processes, and career development.
  • Present designs and strategy to senior internal/external audiences, setting the standard for design review quality.
  • Define test strategy and automation frameworks that reflect real production risk, not checkbox coverage.
  • Participate in on-call rotation as an escalation point for the hardest real-time problems.
  • Lead adoption of AI-native and agentic engineering practices team-wide — owning concrete patterns like AI-assisted root-cause analysis on support requests/alerts before a human engages, building reusable skills/plugins, and reshaping workflows across the SDLC.
  • Coach the team progress along the AI proficiency journey, coaching orchestration-level use of agentic tools and identifying where automation can safely replace manual toil (e.g. approval triage, root-cause drafting, reconciliation queries).

Required Skills:

  • A related technical degree, or equivalent experience
  • 8+ years of professional software development experience, with a track record of technical leadership beyond your own individual contributions
  • Deep knowledge of object oriented programming and expert-level experience with at least one object oriented programming language (Java, JavaScript, C++, C#, Ruby, Python)
  • Proven experience designing observability and monitoring strategy (e.g., New Relic, Splunk, Grafana) at a system or team level, beyond just consuming dashboards others built
  • High proficiency in at least one high-level programming language and web framework (NodeJS, Express, Hapi, etc.)
  • Proven understanding of web technologies, such as JavaScript, CSS, HTML5, XML, JSON, and/or Ajax
  • Validated understanding of database technologies such as SQL, PL/SQL, and relational database schema design, including at scale (data pipelines, large-scale reconciliation, schema correction)
  • Experience designing automated testing strategy and frameworks (Java, JUnit, JSUnit, Selenium) that other engineers build against
  • Demonstrated, hands-on proficiency with agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, agent orchestration/agent teams) applied across the SDLC, including planning, validation, and review workflows, with the judgment to know when to trust automation and when human validation is non-negotiable
  • A strong communicator, experienced explaining complex technical concepts and driving alignment across designers, support, other engineers, and leadership
  • Passion for ensuring the customer has an exceptional experience using our products, and the judgment to prioritize systemic fixes over recurring firefighting
  • Curiosity about systems, and a demonstrated ability to root-cause deep, ambiguous, cross-system puzzles
  • You are motivated by helping other engineers succeed and grow. You proactively look for ways to remove toil, mentor others, and multiply the team's impact beyond your own hands-on work

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience building and operating highly scalable, self-healing web applications and services
  • Experience designing and leading gated, phased production rollouts of automated systems (canary/pilot/full rollout)
  • Experience with Agile software development and test-driven development
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent field, or equivalent depth of experience
  • Comfortable operating with significant autonomy and ambiguity, and driving cross-team consensus without formal authority
  • Track record of contributing reusable tools, skills, or plugins that raised the whole team's (or org's) baseline capability
  • Desire to drive problems to closure, including problems that require convincing other teams to act

We are thrilled to invite ambitious graduate candidates who would like to build a career in Salesforce to apply for the next cohort of our EMEA Graduate Rotation Program - Sales Path.

This exciting 12-month program is designed to give graduates exposure to both sales and solution engineering. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their Salesforce Sales careers. The promotion window opens from month 7 onwards.

Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. You will be assigned experienced Sales Development Buddies who will provide hands-on coaching, invite you to join their discovery and qualification calls, giving you the confidence to pick up the phone to reach out to your first salesforce customers. You will also be paired with experienced Solution Engineer Buddies during the SE Rotation who will involve you in their live deals. Throughout the programme, you will gain exposure to senior sales and solution engineering professionals during our inspiration sessions.

By joining Salesforce, you will have the opportunity to lay the foundation for a fast-paced, successful career. We are a proud member of the Fortune 100 Best Places to Work list for the past 14 years and a consistent winner of Great Place to Work awards.

Who are we looking for?


  • You are a 2025 or 2026 graduate (minimum bachelor’s degree), ideally in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathmatics, Data Analytics or another science discipline. We also welcome graduates from all other academic backgrounds.
  • You are interested in the impact technology can have on the world and business
  • You are a creative problem-solver
  • You are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindset
  • You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning
  • You thrive in a team environment
  • You have excellent interpersonal skills
  • You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment
  • You are fluent in English & Italian is Essential

What does our EMEA Graduate Program look like?


The program is structured as follows:


Introduction Month


During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will:

  • Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values
  • Develop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and tools
  • Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce
  • Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni

Rotations


  • During the Graduate Program, graduates on both the Sales and Solution Engineering Paths will follow the same curriculum and complete the same rotations. Essentially you will gain exposure to both the Sales and Solution Engineering Roles. The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend 60% of your time immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining 40% will focus on role-specific learning. You will be paired with experienced buddies in each path.
  • If your first rotation (months 2 through 4) is in Sales, you will then join the Solution Engineering Rotation from months 5 through 7, and vice versa. Over these six months, you will have built the fundamental skills for these complementary disciplines. Having gone deeper on your solution knowledge, learning how to demo and having exposure to later stages of the sales cycle during the solution engineering rotation will set you up for sucess as you promote throught the various sales roles - SDR, BDR, AE and beyond.

    Throughout the rotations, there will be self-paced certifications and skills assessments. You must meet all eligibility criteria before you can panel for promotion.

Examples of what you can expect during the rotations

Sales Graduate Rotation


  • Learn Salesforce’s best-in-class prospecting and qualification methodologies
  • Learn how to use social, digital, video, chat, and phone platforms to effectively engage Salesforce prospects
  • Collaborate with Sales Development Specialists to run campaigns and help build sales pipeline for the EMEA Sales organisation

Solution Engineering Graduate Rotation


  • Learn our solutions at a deeper, more technical level
  • Work closely with the Solution Engineering organisation, supporting the creation of cutting-edge customer demonstrations
  • Learn the art of customer discovery and how to create a compelling customer point of view

What’s in it for you?


  • A clear and structured career path within our Sales organisation
  • The opportunity to work in an international team within a nurturing environment
  • Access to our diverse internal employee groups
  • A comprehensive benefits package
  • Relocation budget and guidance throughout your relocation process
  • An additional seven days of paid time off for charitable causes – learn more about our 1-1-1 model

Map your future for the coming years


With the EMEA Graduate Program – Sales Path, you can continue to progress:

Introduction Month

Sales Graduate Rotation

  • The opportunity to work in an international team within a nurturing environment
  • Access to our diverse internal employee groups
  • A comprehensive benefits package
  • Relocation budget and guidance throughout your relocation process
  • An additional seven days of paid time off for charitable causes – learn more about our 1-1-1 model

Map your future for the coming years


With the EMEA Graduate Program – Sales Path, you can continue to progress:

The Transformation Communications Lead will be part of our Experience Design organization. Experience Design includes Product Design professionals, UX Engineers & Architects, Researchers, Operations, and Storytellers. Our mission is to turn extraordinary technological capability into extraordinary human value: making the complex coherent, the possible trustworthy, and Salesforce something people can build their work around.

Whether we are discovering the next product innovation or refining our operations, we aim to create experiences that are useful and connected in an agentic enterprise.

We're looking for a Transformation Communications Lead to navigate the organization's transformation to AI-native design and research. You'll be in the room while the transformation is still being defined, helping name what it actually means for designers and researchers, not just explaining it after decisions have landed. In addition to building the messaging infrastructure for priority programs, you'll shape how the org understands and adopts AI-augmented ways of working, from clarifying what the change asks of people all the way through tracking whether it actually landed.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

Success looks like program leads and exec sponsors using your impact analysis to make better decisions before moving forward, producing shared language around the transformation, and increasing adoption of change.

  • Build and run segmented readiness programs, leveling the org into readiness cohorts, designing differentiated messaging per cohort, and tracking migration from awareness to active adoption over time.
  • Co-define change impact for 2-3 priority transformation programs directly with executive sponsors and design program managers, facilitating structured working sessions, producing change summaries, like heat maps and alignment briefs, that align leadership before anything ships.
  • Shape the shared language and organizational narrative that helps the team understand how work is evolving, including who Experience is becoming and why it matters.
  • Write the audience-based communications that help individual contributors and managers understand the direct impact to their day to day practice addressing all dimensions of a change (people, process, tech).
  • Develop the communications that translate the organization's transformation narrative into what it means for daily practice — helping teams understand not just what is changing but what it asks of them.
  • Co-own the end-to-end reinforcement system for each program.

You're Our Person If...

  • 7+ years of experience in change management, organizational communications, or internal communications in a matrixed technology organization, with demonstrated accountability for program adoption outcomes.
  • Demonstrated experience developing audience-segmented communication plans with evidence of producing distinct messaging for different audience groups (e.g., individual contributors, managers, senior leaders) within the same program.
  • Demonstrated experience partnering with senior or executive stakeholders to assess and define the scope of organizational change including producing written artifacts (impact assessments, alignment briefs, stakeholder maps) used to inform program decisions.

  • Demonstrated experience defining and tracking adoption or behavior change metrics including establishing baselines, measuring progress against them, and using data to adjust communications strategy.
  • Applied experience with a recognized change management framework (Prosci ADKAR, Kotter, McKinsey Influence Model, or equivalent) in a professional setting.

Even Better If...

  • Experience establishing a change communications practice, program, or function in an organization where one did not previously exist.
  • Experience working in or alongside a design, UX research, or product organization, familiarity with design and research roles and workflows is a plus for this audience.

Overview

The Success Architect is a trusted technical advisor who provides proactive and reactive Architecture, Technology & Strategy guidance, primarily to Signature customers, and delivers standardized programs to Premier Success Plan customers. Drawing on a strong understanding of the Korean marketing market and marketing domain expertise, you will connect customers' marketing business goals to Marketing Cloud architecture and execution plans. Your goal is to increase customer value realization and adoption while reducing attrition risk.

Responsibilities

Advisory for Signature Customers

  • Analyze and resolve complex technical issues that are difficult for CSMs to resolve, and recommend a path forward.
  • Review and recommend optimizations for Marketing Cloud (Engagement, Personalization, Account Engagement, etc.) architecture, data models, performance, and scalability.
  • Participate in the Architecture Design Review Board to review customers' implementation designs.
  • Deliver Success Architect engagement catalog playbooks, such as health checks and roadmap workshops.
  • Help customers prepare for major product changes, such as feature retirements (End-of-Life).
  • Drive customer adoption of strategic products and key features.
  • Deliver technical briefings to executives and C-level stakeholders, connecting technology strategy to business value and ROI.


Premier Success Plan Program Delivery

  • Onboarding: Provide best practices, configuration guidance, and adoption roadmaps during the initial onboarding of new Premier customers.
  • Success Review: Review customers' adoption status, outcomes, and risks, and present recommendations and next steps.
  • Expert Coaching: Run 1:1 or 1:many coaching sessions for customers' practitioner teams.
  • Provide enablement on specific technical areas upon customer request, including Ask-an-Expert sessions.


Korea Market and Marketing Domain Expertise

  • Advise on channel strategy, Journey design, and campaign design that reflect Korean channel characteristics, such as KakaoTalk Alimtalk/Friendtalk, SMS/LMS, and app push.
  • Provide marketing domain consulting, including marketing maturity assessments, KPI design, and campaign performance improvement.
  • Advise on consent management and data governance in compliance with the Personal Information Protection Act and the Network Act (e.g., opt-in consent for advertising messages, nighttime sending restrictions).
  • Advise on Data Cloud and Sales/Service Cloud integration, segmentation and personalization strategy, and the use of Agentforce and generative AI.


Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing

  • Partner with CSMs, AEs, SEs, Technical Support, Product Management, Professional Services, and partners to build and execute Success Plans.
  • Collaborate with the Japan Success Architect team in specific areas.
  • Identify product feature gaps, propose alternatives, and relay customer feedback to Product and Engineering.
  • Provide technical and product enablement to CSMs.
  • Stay current with Product Management updates and create best practices, knowledge articles, and FAQs for customers and internal teams.
  • Manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously (schedules, stakeholders, deliverables).

Qualifications

Required

  • Extensive experience in one or more of the following: consulting, technical support, CSM/account management, or project management, ideally in a SaaS environment. Approximately 5+ years of experience, adjustable by level.
  • Deep understanding of Marketing Cloud or comparable marketing automation platforms, with implementation, architecture, or advisory experience.

Salesforce aspires to deliver retail business transformation enabled by complex technology.   • Strong analytical & problem-solving skills are essential.
  • Strong influencing capabilities; must be a self-starter, high-energy.
  • Strong appetite to work in a strategic selling environment.
  • Fluent in English and Swedish + Right to work in Sweden.

The Experience

Join the Seller Analytics team in Salesforce's Digital Enterprise Technology organization. We build and run the Sales Data Mesh: our governed, certified data products for Sales, covering our Pipeline Metrics, Annual Order Value, AE and Product Participation, Product Usage, and more. Our consumers are the CRO Analytics team, sales leaders across the globe, and our partner analytics teams in Finance, Revenue, and Marketing.
Our consumers rely on those data products, and this role keeps them trustworthy. You are the first responder; when a consumer reports that a number looks wrong, a dashboard is stale, or a pipeline did not land, you reproduce the problem, find the cause, and resolve-or-route it with a clear writeup. It is an investigate-and-triage role first. Over the first year we will train you to move from operating the mesh to building it, growing into a data engineering role. We are hiring for someone who wants that path.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Triage issues reported by consumers in Slack support channels. Reproduce the problem, establish the grain and definitions involved, and give a clear answer or next step.
  • Investigate data-quality and freshness problems across the bronze to gold layers. Trace a wrong or missing number back to the model, source, or pipeline run that caused it.
  • Run row-level and column-level validation and parity checks when models change or legacy logic is migrated, and confirm the results match.
  • Watch monitoring and alerting (Monte Carlo, dbt tests, source freshness) and act on failures. Open and track the work in Linear.
  • Support hypercare and UAT for launches and migrations. Verify fixes in Snowflake and keep stakeholders updated on status.
  • Keep definitions, grain, and known issues documented so the next question is faster to answer.

Where This Role Grows

  • This is an operate-and-support role today, with a deliberate path into data engineering. As you build SQL and dbt depth, you will take on model changes and tests, and in time build and own mesh data products. If you want to become a data engineer, this role is built for that.

You're Our Person If…

  • You are proficient in Tableau Desktop and/or SQL and can read, debug, and validate queries against real data.
  • You have an investigate-and-triage instinct. You are comfortable not knowing the answer yet and work a problem methodically until you find the cause.
  • You are comfortable in Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse.
  • You communicate clearly in writing and can explain a data issue, its cause, and its fix to a non-engineer.
  • You want to grow into data engineering and are ready to be trained on the rest.

Even Better If…

  • You have used dbt or a similar transformation framework.
  • You have worked with data observability or monitoring tools (e.g. Monte Carlo).
  • You understand dimensional modeling, grain, and surrogate keys.
  • You have done migration or parity work: replacing legacy logic and proving the new results match.

Role Overview

We are looking for a technically strong Security Governance professional who can bridge the gap between Security & Compliance requirements and Engineering implementation.


This role will serve as the technical voice and face of Assurance. You will partner closely with Engineering organizations, PCLs, Product Security, Legal, and other stakeholders to understand how security and compliance requirements are implemented in real systems. You will identify what is working and what is not, and translate those insights back into practical, scalable governance requirements.


The successful candidate will understand systems and architectures deeply enough to move beyond validating whether a control exists. They will evaluate how the control is designed, implemented, operated, and scaled across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Bridge Assurance and Engineering - Serve as a technical liaison between Assurance, Engineering, Product Security, PCLs, Legal, and other stakeholders, ensuring governance requirements are technically feasible, understandable, and implementable.
  • Evaluate Control Implementation - Work directly with Engineering teams to understand how security and compliance controls are implemented within applications, platforms, infrastructure, cloud environments, and engineering workflows.
  • Create the Engineering Feedback Loop - Assess what is working, what is creating unnecessary friction, and where controls or requirements are unclear or difficult to operationalize. Feed those insights back into control design, standards, and governance processes.
  • Make Requirements Engineer-Usable - Translate regulatory, compliance, and security expectations into clear, actionable technical requirements that Engineering teams can consistently implement and validate.
  • Develop Second-Line Oversight - Develop second-line oversight protocols that independently monitor, audit, and validate that all security controls are operational across engineering teams in Salesforce (e.g., attestations, CRE checks).
  • Understand Systems End-to-End - Develop a deep understanding of key platforms, architectures, engineering processes, security capabilities, and control implementations to help Assurance make better risk and compliance decisions.
  • Assess Risk in M&A - Assess control and risk exposure during M&As. Design the assessment to price risk, evaluate compatibility, and deliver an executable activation plan tied back to the risk model.
  • Partner on Emerging Security Requirements - Collaborate with Product Security, Legal, PCEs, Market Enablement, and other teams to understand emerging requirements and determine how they should translate into future security controls and engineering expectations.
  • Track the Direction of Compliance Frameworks - Monitor where regulatory and compliance expectations are heading, including AI governance, the EU AI Act, evolving international requirements, and market-specific regulatory expectations. Proactively identify implications for the organization.
  • Drive Change Management and Enablement - Build the change management, training, and communication needed to shift teams from "go find and interpret a policy" to "know precisely what applies and how to comply."
  • Run Control Incident Management - Stand up a formal incident management practice for control failures. Include postmortems, root-cause analysis, and error budgets for controls, modeled on availability incident response.
  • Influence Future Control Design - Partner with control owners and technical teams to evolve controls based on new technologies, regulatory expectations, architecture changes, and lessons learned from implementation.
  • Drive Security Champion Engagement - Build strong relationships with technical stakeholders across Engineering. Establish a network of security/control champions who can provide implementation feedback, promote requirements, and help scale governance across teams.
  • Report to Executive Leadership - Report on control reliability, coverage, pressure, and systemic risk trends to executive leadership. Feed findings back to the control framework for continuous improvement.
  • Represent Assurance Across Technical Organizations - Act as a trusted technical representative for Assurance in architecture, engineering, security, and governance discussions. Help ensure Assurance is involved early rather than only during audit or compliance validation.

What we're looking for:

  • U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Residency required. We're unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role.
  • 5-6 years of relevant experience or technical background in security engineering, cloud security, product security, IAM, platform engineering, or IT governance.
  • Ability to understand complex systems, architectures, APIs, infrastructure, cloud environments, and software development processes.
  • Experience translating security, risk, regulatory, or compliance requirements into technical implementation requirements.
  • Strong understanding of security controls and frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, SOC, SOX, FedRAMP, or similar frameworks.
  • Familiarity with emerging technology and regulatory areas such as AI security, AI governance, privacy, and evolving global technology regulations.
  • Ability to work effectively with Engineering while also partnering with Legal, Compliance, Security, Risk, and business stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical implementation details to governance teams and translate governance expectations into language Engineering teams can act on.
  • Ability to challenge existing requirements constructively and recommend improvements based on technical realities and risk.
  • Experience with independent control testing, assurance or audit practices, incident or root-cause analysis, or M&A due diligence is a plus.

What Success Looks Like:

Success in this role means creating a strong connection between what Assurance requires and what Engineering can effectively implement. Controls become more technically relevant, and requirements become easier for Engineering teams to consume. Implementation challenges are identified earlier, and emerging security and regulatory expectations are incorporated into the control environment before they become compliance gaps. Control failures are handled with the same rigor as availability incidents, and leadership has clear visibility into control reliability and systemic risk.


Ultimately, this role will help move Assurance from primarily validating compliance to becoming a technical governance partner that actively shapes secure and compliant engineering practices by design.

The Internal Audit Organization is an independent and objective function that assists Salesforce to meet its goals through independent reviews and assessments. Specifically, the Internal Audit Organization evaluates and provides recommendations to enhance the effectiveness, efficiency, and scalability of the company’s processes, information systems, and underlying internal control environment. The Internal Audit Organization also evaluates and assists in improving the effectiveness of the Company’s risk management and governance processes. This function reports administratively to the President and Chief Operating and Financial Officer (COFO) and directly to the Audit and Finance Committee of the Company’s Board of Directors.


Internal Audit is modernizing the way we perform our audits, using technology, AI, and analytics to fuel the transformation. We are looking for an Internal Auditor to excel with an amazing team to support you. You will have the opportunity to support audit activities for the Company’s technology and product functions (e.g., Business Technology, Engineering, Product Management), with a growing focus on how AI and agentic capabilities are adopted, governed, and controlled across these functions.

Success will be measured upon the Auditor successfully executing key tasks, including:

  • Support audits that assess risks and controls over AI and agentic capabilities embedded in business processes — including access and authorization, guardrail enforcement, data grounding, third-party AI/LLM dependencies, and Responsible AI considerations

  • Roadmap Influence: Your field experience routes directly to Product and Engineering. The gaps you hit and the edge cases you encounter in real life customer environments become the features they ship. Senior Forward Deployed Engineers are the most credible voice in agentic AIproduct evolution.
  • Continuous Innovation: You're expected to stay at the forefront — piloting emerging AI tools, experimenting with new models and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.

What You'll Actually Be Building

  • Own end-to-end build and deployment of agentic AI solutions for Salesforce's most strategic customers — from architecture decisions through production handoff.
  • Design and ship agentic systems on the Agentforce platform: agent logic, tool calls, multi-agent orchestration, deterministic guardrails, and the integration patterns that hold up in enterprise environments. Your reference implementations become the basis for how other Builders approach similar problems.
  • Own the data lifecycle: model design, processing pipelines, and data readiness for AI applications across Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer-specific platforms.
  • Resolve the technical blockers that other engineers can't — data integration failures, model deployment issues, orchestration breakdowns, performance regressions. These problems are routed to you because of your track record of solving them.
  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes across engagements.
  • Develop proofs-of-concept and MVPs quickly, with the judgment to know which decisions can be deferred and which need to be right the first time.
  • Codify what you learn. The patterns, reusable assets, and internal frameworks that come out of your real customer work become the playbooks the rest of the org draws from.
  • Mentor other Engineers through code reviews, pair sessions, and shared work. Most of your influence on developing engineers happens inside the same codebases you're building in.
  • Provide technical depth on at-risk or strategically critical deployments when senior engineering judgment is needed.
  • Surface field insights directly to Product and Engineering. The gaps and edge cases you encounter in real customer environments are some of the most valuable inputs to the Agentforce roadmap.
  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist on your team to translate complex customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Senior Forward Deployed Engineer If…

  • You have 6+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with proven end-to-end ownership of scalable production systems in enterprise AI, cloud, or SaaS environments.
  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • You're an expert in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex, and conversant in the others.

  • Partner closely with Product Finance to produce margin and cost-to-serve metrics that inform pricing and packaging decisions
  • Lead token budget allocation and reallocation across organizations: frame trade-offs, run scenarios, and drive alignment with Sr. Leadership

  • Establish governance and chargeback and/or showback processes that hold departments and leaders accountable, working closely with SOX and Accounting
  • Partner with Engineering, Security, Procurement, and FinOps on vendor commitments, consumption tracking, usage optimization, and spend dashboards
  • Contribute to annual planning, long range planning, and budgeting, keeping token assumptions aligned with headcount, infrastructure, and product roadmaps
  • Prepare and present executive-ready materials for council and leadership reviews that turn complex data into clear recommendations

You're Our Person If...

  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience. An MBA is preferred. Experience is evaluated against the role's Core Competencies.
  • You have 8+ years of relevant experience in finance, consulting, or analytics.
  • You have a proven record of driving operational process across departments: standing up forecasting cadences, controls, and governance, and getting multiple teams to follow them without direct authority.
  • You have extensive financial modeling experience, including scenario planning, ROI analysis, unit economics, and margin analysis.
  • You've managed multiple priority initiatives at once and driven operational rigor, such as forecasting cadences and controls.
  • FinOps experience is a plus, including cloud cost management, usage optimization, and showback or chargeback.
  • You're comfortable with financial systems and data tools (e.g., Tableau, Hyperion, SQL, or similar).
  • You can influence senior stakeholders without direct authority and tell a compelling story from complex data.

Even Better If...

  • You have a working understanding of AI and LLM consumption models, such as token-based pricing, committed-spend contracts, and usage-based billing.

  • Lead Veeva-to-Salesforce coexistence, migration and replacement programs, coordinating data migration, cutover and parallel-run strategies in partnership with the delivery team
  • Perform project management activities that ensure adherence to Salesforce methodology, project gates and governance (steering committees, status reporting, decision logs)
  • Anticipate and remove obstacles that slow down or prevent teams from delivering on project goals; act as the primary escalation point for delivery issues

Own the Commercials

  • Own engagement financials: revenue recognition, margin, forecasting, utilisation and resourcing across your portfolio
  • Supervise utilization of project resources in alignment with resource allocation and budget, including timely entry and approvals of project timesheets
  • Manage scope and change control rigorously; identify, negotiate and land change requests to protect margin and outcomes
  • Partner with Sales and pre-sales on shaping, estimating, staffing and de-risking Life Sciences opportunities and SOWs
  • Work as an extension of the account team to extend the Salesforce footprint

Manage Risk, Quality & Compliance

  • Identify, quantify and mitigate delivery risk early; maintain risk, issue and dependency management across the program
  • Participate in end-to-end implementation planning, including risk and issue management, communication and business organizational change
  • Ensure delivery meets the regulatory and compliance expectations of the industry (GxP, CSV/validation, 21 CFR Part 11, GDPR, Sunshine Act / transparency regulations, consent and data privacy), coordinating validation and quality activities within the project plan
  • Govern quality gates, cutover readiness and go-live criteria in partnership with the delivery team
  • Facilitate User Acceptance Testing with business end users, including coordination and user acceptance sign-off

Advise & Influence

  • Be the trusted delivery advisor of customer IT and business leadership, translating business strategy and regulatory constraints into a pragmatic, deliverable roadmap
  • Facilitate requirements gathering and assist with crafting project deliverables and Salesforce documentation as needed
  • Build and sustain senior customer relationships; manage expectations and satisfaction (CSAT) throughout the engagement
  • Produce and own the key delivery artefacts: statement of work, delivery plan, governance model, RAID log, status reporting, and go-live / cutover plans
  • Represent Salesforce Professional Services in executive conversations, steering committees and customer events

Enable & Grow

  • Mentor and coach Engagement Managers and Delivery Leads, building the next generation of delivery leaders in the practice
  • Build and share Life Sciences and Veeva-related delivery assets, accelerators, playbooks and lessons learned across Iberia and EMEA
  • Drive delivery excellence and champion adoption of AI tooling in delivery
  • Maintain and grow certifications aligned with the practice (project management, Life Sciences, Agentforce, Data Cloud)
  • Lead delivery community sessions, internal reviews and knowledge-sharing initiatives

You're Our Person If...

  • 7+ years of professional services, consulting, or program/project management experience, with 3+ years managing complex technology implementations (Salesforce platform experience strongly preferred)
  • Proven track record owning end-to-end delivery and financials of enterprise programs (scope, timeline, margin, quality, CSAT), including external client projects with a focus on software development, CRM and SaaS environments
  • Proven experience in Life Sciences (pharma, biotech, medtech) delivering with Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud / Health Cloud and/or Veeva Systems (CRM, Vault, Network), including coexistence or migration scenarios
  • Solid understanding of Life Sciences commercial and medical processes: HCP/HCO engagement, call planning, omnichannel, samples, consent management, MLR/approved content, field force operations
  • Working knowledge of industry regulation and compliance: GxP, computer system validation, 21 CFR Part 11, GDPR, transparency and aggregate-spend reporting
  • Ability to balance business and technical requirements to produce a project plan, and to lead enterprise-wide engagements, facilitating meetings with client executives and proactively managing project risks, dependencies and estimates
  • Demonstrated project management skills, with direct responsibility for leading project teams of 10+ members and managing budgets and schedules
  • Demonstrated ability to have difficult conversations, with a proven track record of delivering high-quality results on time and within budget
  • Experience managing and maintaining clear communication with remote consultants, with outstanding interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills
  • Practical, daily use of AI tools (Agentforce-style assistants, ChatGPT/Claude) for planning, reporting and productivity
  • Fluent in Spanish and English (Portuguese is a plus for our Iberia coverage)
  • Availability to travel regionally, and occasionally internationally, depending on customer needs

Even Better If...

  • Project management methodology certification such as PMP, SAFe or Scrum
  • Experience leading one or more Veeva-to-Salesforce migration programs as engagement / delivery owner
  • Hands-on delivery of Agentforce or Data Cloud use cases in Life Sciences (e.g. HCP assistants, medical inquiry, field rep copilots)

  • Pre-sales skills and enterprise change management experience
  • Experience with enterprise-scale integration solutions and cloud technology, or equivalent
  • Experience implementing enterprise-scale CRM software across Sales, Service, Marketing and Commerce

title: Strategic Solution Engineer (Retail/CPG/Life Sciences)
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience


Strategic Solution Engineer（Strategic SE）は、エンタープライズ領域（特にB2Cリテール・消費財・ライフサイエンス等のインダストリー）における最重要・大規模顧客および高難度な商談に対し、戦略的なソリューション・アーキテクチャの立案と技術提案を担うエキスパート職です。個別の製品導入にとどまらず、プロダクト横断の視点からSalesforceの全製品群（Agentforce, Data 36O、Data Foundations、 Marketing Cloud、Commerce Cloud、Industry Cloud、Tableau、Slack等）およびパートナーエコシステムを統合し、お客様の経営課題解決や事業変革Visionを現実的かつ高度なアーキテクチャとして実現します。


個別の案件進行を担うアカウント担当ソリューションエンジニア（Account SE）と連携し、より広範なIT環境や長期的な技術視点からアーキテクチャ構想を支える専門スペシャリストとして活動します。製品の枠組みにとらわれない統合的な製品カバー力（All Products）を発揮します。


顧客の信頼を獲得しビジネスを推進してきた経験をベースに、個別の提案活動を超えて業界全体のテクノロジー構想、パートナー協業、チームへの技術ナレッジ共有、経営層（CxOレベル）とのExecutive Alignmentへと活躍の場を広げることができるポジションです。


What You'll Actually Be Doing


  • 最重点アカウントへの深い参画と中長期IT戦略の推進
    • 中長期アカウント戦略の立案: 営業チームやアカウント担当SEと密に連携し、お客様の2〜3年先を見据えたIT変革ロードマップおよびアカウントプランを共同で策定・推進します。
    • 経営層・ITリーダーとの関係構築: お客様のCIO、CTO、IT部門責任者等のキーマンと対話し、定期的なディスカッションや戦略レビューを通じて中長期的な信頼関係を築きます。
    • 大型・複雑案件のソリューション牽引: 非常に高度な技術要件やシステム構成が求められる提案において、アーキテクチャ全体の設計やコンセプトの可視化をリードし、提案活動を成功に導きます。
  • インダストリー強化 & パートナー・エコシステム連携
    • 業界トレンドに沿ったアーキテクチャ構想: インダストリー専門アドバイザーと協業し、最新の業界動向と技術プラットフォーム（自律型AI AgentforceやData Cloud等）を組み合わせた最適なソリューションモデルを策定します。
    • 既存システム環境との統合設計: お客様が保有するマルチDWHや基幹系システムとSalesforceプラットフォームのデータ連携・システム統合アーキテクチャを設計・最適化します。
    • アライアンス・パートナー協業の推進: エコシステムパートナー（データ連携、DevOps、AppExchange等）との共同ソリューション設計や市場展開を推進します。
    • 外部カンファレンス・イベントでの発信: 大型ITイベントやエグゼクティブ向けセッションでの登壇・事例紹介を通じて、最先端の技術価値を広く発信します。
  • 組織への貢献・ナレッジシェア & チーム育成サポート
    • ソリューションアセットの共有: 高難度案件で確立したアーキテクチャパターンや提案フレームワークを標準化し、ソリューションエンジニアリング組織全体へ展開します。
    • メンバーへのメンタリング・協業: 案件を通じたOJTやナレッジの相互共有を行い、チーム全体の技術力や提案クオリティ向上に貢献します。

You're Our Person If...


  • エンタープライズIT領域（CRM, AI, データ統合基盤, クラウドアーキテクチャ等）におけるソリューション設計および技術提案経験（10年以上推奨）
  • CIO/CTO/IT部長など、経営層・IT役員レベルに対するプレゼンテーションおよび合意形成（Executive Alignment）の実績
  • 複雑なビジネス課題を捉え、中長期の技術構想やシステムアーキテクチャへ落とし込む論理的思考力
  • 営業、ソリューションエンジニア、専門アドバイザー、パートナー企業など、多様なステークホルダーと円滑に協業するコミュニケーション・オーケストレーション能力
  • 最先端技術（AI, データ基盤等）への高い好奇心と自発的な学習・検証意欲
  • 流暢レベルの日本語能力
  • コンピュータサイエンス、ソフトウェアエンジニアリング、MIS（経営情報システム）の学士号（B.S.）、またはそれと同等の実務経験

Even Better If...


  • リテール（百貨店/スーパー/コンビニ/アパレル/専門店/飲食）、消費財、ライフサイエンス等の業界知識および提案・導入経験
  • Salesforceプラットフォーム（Sales/Service/Marketing/Commerce Cloud, Data Cloud, Agentforce, Tableau, Slack）に関する知識または設計・構築実績
  • 基幹系システム（ERP, CRM, 統合DWH, API基盤等）とのシステム連携・エンタープライズ統合アーキテクチャの設計経験
  • 社内メンバーへの指導・育成（メンタリング・OJT）や組織的なナレッジ共有への貢献実績
  • ビジネスレベルの英語力（グローバルチームとの連携、海外最新情報の収集など）

当ポジションの魅力・キャリアパス

日本を代表する大手企業の変革に寄与: 個別システムの導入にとどまらず、業界をリードするエンタープライズ企業の経営層とともに未来のIT姿を描く、社会的インパクトの大きい役割です。

最先端テクノロジー（AI×Data）の実践: 自律型AI（Agentforce）や次世代データプラットフォーム（Data Cloud）をはじめ、時代を先駆けるテクノロジーを駆使した高度なソリューション設計に挑戦できます。

ソリューションエンジニアとしての専門性とキャリアの拡大: 高度なアーキテクチャ設計力、Executive交渉力、広域なソリューション展開力を磨き、ソリューションエンジニアとして市場価値の高いキャリアを形成できます。


The Experience


The Strategic Solution Engineer (Strategic SE) is an expert who designs strategic solution architectures and leads technical proposals for the most important, large-scale enterprise customers and the most complex deals, especially in industries such as B2C retail, consumer goods, and life sciences. Going beyond individual product implementations, you will take a cross-product view and integrate Salesforce's full product portfolio (Agentforce, Data 36O, Data Foundations, Marketing Cloud, Commerce Cloud, Industry Cloud, Tableau, Slack, etc.) and the partner ecosystem, turning customers' management challenges and business transformation Vision into realistic, advanced architectures.


You will work alongside Account Solution Engineers (Account SEs), who drive individual deals, as a specialist who supports architectural vision from a broader IT landscape and long-term technology perspective. You will bring integrated coverage across all products (All Products), not limited to any single product framework.


Building on your experience earning customer trust and driving business, you can expand your impact beyond individual proposals to industry-wide technology vision, partner collaboration, sharing technical knowledge with the team, and Executive Alignment with C-level leaders (CxO).

    • Mid- to long-term account strategy: Work closely with the sales team and Account SEs to jointly develop and drive an IT transformation roadmap and account plan looking 2–3 years ahead.

    • Architecture vision aligned with industry trends: Work with industry advisors to define optimal solution models that combine the latest industry trends with technology platforms (such as autonomous AI Agentforce and Data Cloud).
    • Integration design with existing systems: Design and optimize data integration and system integration architectures between customers' multiple data warehouses and core systems and the Salesforce platform.
    • Alliance and partner collaboration: Drive joint solution design and go-to-market with ecosystem partners (data integration, DevOps, AppExchange, etc.).
    • Sharing at external conferences and events: Communicate cutting-edge technology value broadly through speaking and case presentations at major IT events and executive sessions.
  • Organizational contribution, knowledge sharing, and team development
    • Sharing solution assets: Standardize architecture patterns and proposal frameworks established on complex deals and roll them out across the Solution Engineering organization.
    • Mentoring and collaboration: Provide on-the-job training through deals and share knowledge with team members, helping raise the team's technical skills and proposal quality.

  • Track record of presenting to and building consensus with executive and IT leadership such as CIOs, CTOs, and IT department heads (Executive Alignment)
  • Logical thinking to grasp complex business challenges and translate them into mid- to long-term technology vision and system architecture
  • Communication and orchestration skills to collaborate smoothly with diverse stakeholders such as sales, solution engineers, specialist advisors, and partner companies
  • Strong curiosity about cutting-edge technology (AI, data platforms, etc.) and a self-driven motivation to learn and test
  • Fluent-Level Japanese
  • Bachelor's degree (B.S.) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or MIS (Management Information Systems), or equivalent practical experience

  • Knowledge of, or design and build experience with, Salesforce platforms (Sales/Service/Marketing/Commerce Cloud, Data Cloud, Agentforce, Tableau, Slack)

  • Put cutting-edge technology (AI × Data) into practice: Take on advanced solution design using leading technologies such as autonomous AI (Agentforce) and the next-generation data platform (Data Cloud).
